This state of mind is moreover the starting point of the unique path, and a special cause for achieving omniscience.

6664.acip: NYER LEN ZHES PA DE, NYER LEN NGO BO 'GYUR BA MED PAR NYER LEN CAN TE DE'I 'BRAS BU 'GYUR BA BYED MI NUS PAR DE'I NGO BO TZAM GYI MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAG RJES DNGOS SU 'JOG BYED YIN PA ZHIG DGOS TE, DPER NA, 'JIM PA 'GYUR BA MED PAR RDZA'I BUM PA SOGS MI 'GYUR BA BZHIN NO, ,
6664.wylie: nyer len zhes pa de, nyer len ngo bo 'gyur ba med par nyer len can te de'i 'bras bu 'gyur ba byed mi nus par de'i ngo bo tsam gyi mthun mong ma yin pa'i lag rjes dngos su 'jog byed yin pa zhig dgos te, dper na, 'jim pa 'gyur ba med par rdza'i bum pa sogs mi 'gyur ba bzhin no,
6664.english: What we call a "material" cause is such that it could never cause "what had it" (meaning its result) to come about unless the very essence of this material cause were to undergo a change itself. So what we need for a material cause is something which, by its very nature, imparts--in a very immediate way--its own unique affect. Examples would be a ceramic pitcher or such, which could never occur without a change in the clay.

6709.acip: LAS DE YANG KUN NAS SLONG BA NI PHRA RGYAS YIN NO, ZHES BSTAN PA'I PHYIR DE'I RJES LA GNAS LNGA PA DANG , PHRA RGYAS DE DAG SPONG BYED NI LAM YIN NO ZHES BSTAN PA'I PHYIR DE'I RJES LA GNAS DRUG PA DANG , DER SMOS PA'I SHES PA BYE BRAG TU BSTAN PA'I PHYIR DE'I RJES LA GNAS BDUN PA DANG , DE LAS NI SANGS RGYAS LA THUN MONG MA YIN PA DANG THUN MONG BA'I YON TAN GNYIS BSTAN PA LAS THUN MONG BA RGYAS PAR BSHAD PA'I PHYIR DE'I RJES LA GNAS BRGYAD PA BSTAN TO,
6709.wylie: las de yang kun nas slong ba ni phra rgyas yin no, zhes bstan pa'i phyir de'i rjes la gnas lnga pa dang , phra rgyas de dag spong byed ni lam yin no zhes bstan pa'i phyir de'i rjes la gnas drug pa dang , der smos pa'i shes pa bye brag tu bstan pa'i phyir de'i rjes la gnas bdun pa dang , de las ni sangs rgyas la thun mong ma yin pa dang thun mong ba'i yon tan gnyis bstan pa las thun mong ba rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir de'i rjes la gnas brgyad pa bstan to
6709.english: The message of the next chapter, the fifth, is that the motivating force behind the deeds outlined in Chapter Four is the widespread mental afflictions. The sixth chapter is devoted to demonstrating a path by which we may eliminate these afflictions, so naturally comes after their presentation. The seventh chapter provides additional detail about the types of knowledge mentioned in the sixth; the eighth, lastly, completes the interrelationship of the chapters by enlarging upon the qualities which the Buddha possesses in common with advanced beings at lower stages--these qualities and those unique to the Buddha having first appeared in Chapter Seven.

6833.acip: ,DE LA RMA BYA LA SOGS PA'I MDONGS LA SOGS PA SNA TSOGS PA NI, SEMS CAN DE RNAMS KHO NA'I LAS THUN MONG MA YIN PAS SKYED PA'O, , PAD MA LA SOGS PA'I 'DAB MA DANG KHA DOG SNA TSOGS PA NI, SEMS CAN GYI THUN MONG GI LAS KYIS BSKYED PA'O, , DE BZHIN DU GZHAN LA'ANG SHES PAR BYA'O,
6833.wylie: de la rma bya la sogs pa'i mdongs la sogs pa sna tshogs pa ni, sems can de rnams kho na'i las thun mong ma yin pas skyed pa'o, , pad ma la sogs pa'i 'dab ma dang kha dog sna tshogs pa ni, sems can gyi thun mong gi las kyis bskyed pa'o, , de bzhin du gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o
6833.english: On this subject, the intricate patterns on a peacock and other such objects are produced by each one's personal karma. The intricacies of the petals and colors of a lotus flower and other such things are produced by the collective karma of living beings. You can apply these principles to all other cases as well.

6861.acip: DE LTAR 'BYUNG BA DE YANG BRLAN ZHING GSHER BA PHOR PA GANG PO DE BLTA BYA THUN MONG BA YIN PA'I DBANG DU BYAS PA YIN GYI, YI DVAGS KYIS LAG TU BLANGS NAS LONGS SPYOD PAR BRTZAMS PA DE'I TSE NA KHYAD CHOS GSUM LDAN DU SKYE BA MA YIN TE, DE'I TSE NA YI DVAGS KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LONGS SPYOD BYA YIN PAS, RIGS 'DRA PHYI MA RNAG KHRAG TU SKYE BA YIN PA'I PHYIR,
6861.wylie: de ltar 'byung ba de yang brlan zhing gsher ba phor pa gang po de blta bya thun mong ba yin pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi, yi dvags kyis lag tu blangs nas longs spyod par brtsams pa de'i tshe na khyad chos gsum ldan du skye ba ma yin te, de'i tshe na yi dvags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i longs spyod bya yin pas, rigs 'dra phyi ma rnag khrag tu skye ba yin pa'i phyir
6861.english: What we just described as happening is only with reference to where a glass of something wet and flowing is an object shared by the three different beings, as they look at it together. When the craving spirit himself though picks up the glass in his hand and begins to partake of its contents, the glass of liquid is no longer something that exists with three different parts. Since at this point it is something that the craving spirit is experiencing exclusively, its continuation starts being pus and blood.

6862.acip: DANG POR GANG DU GNAS PA DE YANG 'GRO BA GSUM PO DE'I RANG RANG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAS LA BRTEN NAS GRUB PA'I SNOD KYI 'JIG RTEN GANG NAS BLANGS PA DE NYID DU GRUB PA YIN TE, MI'I THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAS LA BRTEN NAS GRUB PAS MI'I 'JIG RTEN GYI CHU DVANGS SHING BSIL BA NAS BLANGS NA DE NYID DU GNAS PA SOGS YIN PA'I PHYIR,
6862.wylie: dang por gang du gnas pa de yang 'gro ba gsum po de'i rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i las la brten nas grub pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten gang nas blangs pa de nyid du grub pa yin te, mi'i thun mong ma yin pa'i las la brten nas grub pas mi'i 'jig rten gyi chu dvangs shing bsil ba nas blangs na de nyid du gnas pa sogs yin pa'i phyir
6862.english: How the glass of liquid exists originally all depends on the particular outer world from where it has been taken, for each of the three different beings has a different outer world, depending on the specific karma he himself has collected. If the glass of liquid were sweet, cool water taken from the world of humans--a world created by the specific karma of the human in the group--then that would be its original condition, and so on. 33 Who Made Hell?

7009.acip: ,KHA DOG LA SOGS PHUN SUM DNGOS, ,DE LAS GZUGS BZANG GRAGS LDAN DANG , ,DGA' DANG SHIN TU GZHON SHA DANG , ,DUS SU REG NA BDE LUS 'GYUR,
7009.wylie: kha dog la sogs phun sum dngos, ,de las gzugs bzang grags ldan dang , ,dga' dang shin tu gzhon sha dang , ,dus su reg na bde lus 'gyur
7009.english: Things given, excellent color and such. From it an excellent form and reputation, Happiness and a very youthful complexion, A body which in each time's pleasant to touch.

7133.acip: ,SPRIN NI KLU SOGS KYI BSAM PA'I DBANG GIS MKHA' LA SKYE ZHING 'JIG PA LTAR 'DUS BYAS RNAMS NI, THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAS DBANG GIS SKYE 'JIG BYED BAR 'GYUR ZHES PA'I DPE RNAMS KYIS KYANG 'DUS BYAS THAMS CAD BDEN MED DU BSHAD DO,
7133.wylie: sprin ni klu sogs kyi bsam pa'i dbang gis mkha' la skye zhing 'jig pa ltar 'dus byas rnams ni, thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i las dbang gis skye 'jig byed bar 'gyur zhes pa'i dpe rnams kyis kyang 'dus byas thams cad bden med du bshad do
7133.english: Clouds are something that gather and fade in the sky, depending on the wishes of the serpent-beings and such. Things brought about by causes are the same; depending on the influence of karma which is either communal or not, they rise or die out. Each of the metaphors above is also meant to represent how no object brought about by causes has any true existence. ************

7528.acip: ZHES PAS STON LA, DON NI, DE YANG SO THAR GYI SDOM PA GTONG BA'I RGYU LA SO THAR RIS BRGYAD KA'I GTONG RGYU THUN MONG BA DANG , SO SO'I GTONG RGYU THUN MONG MA YIN PA GNYIS YOD PA LAS, YUL DGE SLONG SOGS KYI MDUN DU BSLAB PA 'BUL LO, ZHES SOGS KYI CHO GA BRJOD NAS BSLAB PA PHUL BA DANG , SHI 'PHOS PA DANG , PHO MO'I MTSAN MA GNYIS CIG CAR DU BYUNG BA DANG , MTSAN LAN GSUM DU GYUR PA DANG , DGE BA'I RTZA BA CHAD PA STE LOG LTA SKYES PA RNAMS NI THUN MONG GI GTONG RGYU'O ZHES PA'O,
7528.wylie: zhes pas ston la, don ni, de yang so thar gyi sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu la so thar ris brgyad ka'i gtong rgyu thun mong ba dang , so so'i gtong rgyu thun mong ma yin pa gnyis yod pa las, yul dge slong sogs kyi mdun du bslab pa 'bul lo, zhes sogs kyi cho ga brjod nas bslab pa phul ba dang , shi 'phos pa dang , pho mo'i mtshan ma gnyis cig car du byung ba dang , mtshan lan gsum du gyur pa dang , dge ba'i rtsa ba chad pa ste log lta skyes pa rnams ni thun mong gi gtong rgyu'o zhes pa'o
7528.english: The two causes for losing your vows are the shared causes for losing any of the eight types of individual freedom vows, and the unique causes for losing certain ones of them. The shared causes for losing any of the vows are the following: returning your vows by pronouncing the words of the ritual for returning them, where you say "I give back my vows..." and so on in the presence of a fully-ordained monk or the like; dying and moving on to your next birth; having both male and female sexual organs appear on you simultaneously; changing sexes three times; or cutting the very root of your virtue by holding wrong views.

8750.acip: 'DIR RANG GI MTSAN NYID CES PA RGYA NAG GI 'GREL CHEN SOGS LAS THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I MTSAN NYID LA BSHAD PA NI RIGS PA MA YIN TE, MDO NYID LAS KUN BRTAGS KYI SKABS SU RANG GI MTSAN NYID GYIS GRUB PA LA GSAL BAR GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR DANG , KUN BRTAGS LA'ANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I MTSON BYED YOD PAS MTSAN NYID NGO BO NYID MED PA KUN BRTAGS LA BSHAD DU MI RUNG BA'I SKYON DU 'GYUR BA'I PHYIR RO, ,
8750.wylie: 'dir rang gi mtshan nyid ces pa rgya nag gi 'grel chen sogs las thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid la bshad pa ni rigs pa ma yin te, mdo nyid las kun brtags kyi skabs su rang gi mtshan nyid gyis grub pa la gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang , kun brtags la'ang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshon byed yod pas mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa kun brtags la bshad du mi rung ba'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro,
8750.english: The term here "definitive characteristic" or "definition" [in "having definitive characteristics" or "existing by definition"] has been explained in the great Chinese commentary and elsewhere as referring to the particular verbal definition of a thing. This idea though is incorrect, since--for one thing--the sutra itself clearly refers to the idea of existing by definition in the parts where it talks about constructs. Furthermore, even constructs have their own particular verbal descriptions which are used to define them; so if this were the meaning of "definition" here then there would be a problem if we went on to describe them as not having any nature or definitive characteristics of their own.

8871.acip: DES NA BLO GNOD MED LA SNANG BA'I DBANG GIS BZHAG PA MA YIN PAR YUL RANG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BSDOD LUGS KYI NGOS NAS GRUB PA DE, DON DAM LA DPYOD PA'I RTAGS KYI DGAG CHOS MTHAR THUG YIN TE,
8871.wylie: des na blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag pa ma yin par yul rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa de, don dam la dpyod pa'i rtags kyi dgag chos mthar thug yin te
8871.english: Therefore the following is the final form of the idea denied by the reasoning which examines the ultimate: Anything which existed from its own side with its own unique identity, rather than being simply established as existing by appearing to an unaffected state of mind.

8875.acip: LUGS 'DI'I BDEN GNYIS 'JOG TSUL DPE DANG BCAS PA 'CHAD PA LA, GZUGS SOGS KYI CHOS 'DI RNAMS SNANG PHYOGS NAS BLO GNOD MED LA SNANG BA'I DBANG GIS PHAR BZHAG PA TZAM DANG , STONG PHYOGS NAS BLO GNOD MED LA SNANG BA'I DBANG GIS BZHAG PA MA YIN PAR YUL RANG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BSDOD LUGS KYI NGOS NAS GRUB PAS STONG PA GCIG DGOS TE,
8875.wylie: lugs 'di'i bden gnyis 'jog tshul dpe dang bcas pa 'chad pa la, gzugs sogs kyi chos 'di rnams snang phyogs nas blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis phar bzhag pa tsam dang , stong phyogs nas blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag pa ma yin par yul rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pas stong pa gcig dgos te
8875.english: Here we will explain how this school decides what the two realities are, using some metaphors as well. Two things have to be present with all of these objects: with physical matter and every other existing thing. From the point of view of what appears in the world, they must be established as existing from our side--merely by virtue of their appearing to an unaffected state of mind. From the point of view of emptiness, they must be void of any kind of existence where the object exists from its own side through its own unique identity, rather than by virtue of its appearing to an unaffected state of mind.

8879.acip: GZUGS SOGS KYI CHOS RNAMS BLO GNOD MED LA SNANG BA'I DBANG GIS BZHAG TZAM DU GSUNGS PA'I TZAM SGRAS KYANG , DE'I DBANG GIS BZHAG PA MA YIN PAR YUL RANG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BSDOD LUGS KYI DBANG GIS GRUB PA GCOD KYANG , MING BRDAS BZHAG TZAM MA YIN PAR GRUB PA MI GCOD DE,
8879.wylie: gzugs sogs kyi chos rnams blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag tsam du gsungs pa'i tsam sgras kyang , de'i dbang gis bzhag pa ma yin par yul rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsdod lugs kyi dbang gis grub pa gcod kyang , ming brdas bzhag tsam ma yin par grub pa mi gcod de
8879.english: Consider, by the way, the word "merely" when we speak of physical matter and all other existing objects as being "things which are established as existing merely by virtue of their appearing to an unaffected state of mind." Its use is meant to disallow the idea that these things could be established by virtue of some unique identity of the object itself, rather than being established as existing by virtue of this appearing. It is not however meant to disallow the idea that things do not exist merely through names and terms.

8886.acip: BLO GNOD MED LA SNANG BA'I DBANG GIS BZHAG PA MA YIN PAR YUL RANG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BSDOD LUGS KYI NGOS NAS MA GRUB STE, DE GRUB NA, GNAS LUGS MTHAR THUG TU GRUB DGOS, DER GRUB NA, BLO MA 'KHRUL BA GNAS LUGS MNGON SUM DU RTOGS PA'I SLOB PA 'PHAGS PA'I MNYAM GZHAG YE SHES KYIS MNGON SUM DU RTOGS DGOS PA LA MNGON SUM DU MA RTOGS PA'I PHYIR,
8886.wylie: blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag pa ma yin par yul rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsdod lugs kyi ngos nas ma grub ste, de grub na, gnas lugs mthar thug tu grub dgos, der grub na, blo ma 'khrul ba gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i slob pa 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes kyis mngon sum du rtogs dgos pa la mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir
8886.english: They do not, however, exist from their own side through some unique identity of their own, without being established as existing by virtue of appearing to an unaffected state of mind. This is because--if they were to exist this way--then they would have to be some ultimate nature. And if they were some ultimate nature, then they would have to be something which is perceived directly by a certain unmistaken state of mind: that meditative wisdom of a realized being who is not yet a Buddha, and who perceives the real nature of things directly. The fact is though that they are not.

8922.acip: DANG POR GANG DU GNAS PA DE YANG 'GRO BA GSUM PO DE'I RANG RANG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAS LA BRTEN NAS GRUB PA'I SNOD KYI 'JIG RTEN GANG NAS BLANGS PA DE NYID DU GRUB PA YIN TE, MI'I THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAS LA BRTEN NAS GRUB PAS MI'I 'JIG RTEN GYI CHU DVANGS SHING BSIL BA NAS BLANGS NA DE NYID DU GNAS PA SOGS YIN PA'I PHYIR,

8922.english: How the glass of liquid exists originally all depends on the particular outer world from where it has been taken, for each of the three different beings has a different outer world, depending on the specific karma he himself has collected. If the glass of liquid were sweet, cool water taken from the world of humans--a world created by the specific karma of the human in the group--then that would be its original condition, and so on.

8943.acip: ,'DIR ZAB LAM N'A RO'I CHOS DRUG CES KUN TU GRAGS PA'I GDAMS NGAG 'CHAD PA LA GNYIS TE, GANG LA BRTEN NAS LAM 'DI SGOM PA'I SNGON 'GRO DANG, DE LA BRTEN NAS LAM 'DI JI LTAR BSGOM PA'O, ,DANG PO LA GNYIS, SNGON 'GRO DANG PO THEG CHEN THUN MONG BA'I LAM DANG, THUN MONG MA YIN PA BLA MED KYI THEG PA'I SNGON 'GRO'O,

8943.english: Our presentation of the advices widely known as the "Profound Path of the Six Practices of Naropa" will proceed in two steps: a discussion of the preliminaries that lead one into the practice of this path, and the actual path that one practices, led there through the preliminaries. The first of these has two divisions of its own: the initial preliminaries--that is, the path which is shared throughout the greater way; and the unique preliminaries of the unsurpassed way.

10102.acip: SNANG BAS YOD MTHA' DANG STONG PAS MED MTHA' SEL BA'I THAL 'GYUR THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I KHYAD CHOS RTEN 'BYUNG ZAB MO'I TSUL LA THUGS NGES KHYAD PAR CAN THOB NAS LTA BA'I MGUR DBYANGS 'DI LTAR MDZAD DE,
10102.wylie: snang bas yod mtha' dang stong pas med mtha' sel ba'i thal 'gyur thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rten 'byung zab mo'i tshul la thugs nges khyad par can thob nas lta ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di ltar mdzad de
10102.english: He was able thus to attain an extraordinary insight into the way of profound dependent origination--a way which has as its distinctive feature the unique position of the Consequence Group of the Middle Way: the belief that an understanding of what appears to us prevents the extreme of thinking that things exist the way they seem; while an understanding of emptiness prevents the opposite extreme, of thinking that nothing exists at all.  He then wrote the following song of spiritual experience.

10325.acip: ,GNYIS MED THUN MONG MA YIN KHYAB PA'I SKU, ,KUN LA SNYOMS MDZAD RGYAL BA KUN GYI YAB, ,CHOS KYI DBYINGS GYUR RGYAL BA KUN GYI YUM, ,YE SHES SEMS DPA' RGYAL BA KUN GYI SRAS,
10325.wylie: gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku, ,kun la snyoms mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yab, ,chos kyi dbyings gyur rgyal ba kun gyi yum, ,ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi sras
10325.english: Your holy body is indivisible, extraordinary, and covers all things; You are the Father of all Victors, Equal towards All. You are the Mother of all Victors, the Nature of the Dharma; You are the Son of all Victors, Spiritual Warrior of Wisdom.

10662.acip: (,GNYIS PA BZHUGS NAS DBANG BLANG BA LA BZHI, BUM PA, GSANG BA, SHES RAB YE SHES, DBANG BZHI PA'O, ,DANG BO LA GNYIS, THUN MONG BA RDO RJE SLOB MA'I DBANG DANG, THUN MONG MA YIN PA RDO RJE SLOB DPON GYI DBANG NGO, ,DANG PO LA LNGA, CHU, COD PAN, RDO RJE, DRIL BU, MING GI DBANG NGO,,)
10662.wylie: (,gnyis pa bzhugs nas dbang blang ba la bzhi, bum pa, gsang ba, shes rab ye shes, dbang bzhi pa'o, ,dang bo la gnyis, thun mong ba rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang, thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo, ,dang po la lnga, chu, cod pan, rdo rje, dril bu, ming gi dbang ngo,,)
10662.english: (This then brings us to the second part of the ceremony: taking the initiation, once you have entered into the secret world.  This section has four parts: the Initation of the Vase; the Initation of the Secret; the Initiation of Infinite Wisddom; and the Fourth Initiation. The first of these initiations comes itself in two types: the Common Initiation, or the initiation of a Diamond Disciple; and the Uncommon Initiation, or the initiation of a Diamond Master. The first type of initiation, the common, entails five separate empowerments: the Empowerment of Sacred Water; the Empowerment of the Crown; the Empowerment of the Diamond; the Empowerment of the Bell; and the Empowerment of the Name.) 52) The empowerment is requested

10826.acip: (GNYIS PA THUN MONG MA YIN PA RDO RJE SLOB DPON GYI DBANG LA GNYIS, DBANG DNGOS DANG, DE'I MTHA' RTEN NO, ,DANG PO NI,]
10826.wylie: (gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la gnyis, dbang dngos dang, de'i mtha' rten no, ,dang po ni,]
10826.english: (This brings us to the second general division within the Initiations of the Vase: the uncommon inititiation, the Empowerment of a Diamond Master.  We proceed in two steps: the actual empowerment, and then sealing this empowerment.  Here then is the first.) 78) The empowerment is requested

11008.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA RLUNG LA NGAG TU GSUNGS PA'I DRI MA RLUNG SNGAGS SO SOR SNANG ZHING ZHEN PA'I DRI MA 'KHRUD PAS NA GSUNG RDO RJE SBYONG,
11008.wylie: thun mong ma yin pa rlung la ngag tu gsungs pa'i dri ma rlung sngags so sor snang zhing zhen pa'i dri ma 'khrud pas na gsung rdo rje sbyong
11008.english: The unique result of this initiation is that cleaned free the diamond of your words: your enlightened speech.  You are cleaned of a very special impurity relating to the statement that "the inner winds are what you say"; that is, you are cleaned of the tendency for your inner winds and your mantras to appear to you as things which are separate from each other--and you are cleaned of your tendency to believe it when they appear this way.

11043.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA GANG SNANG KUN BDE STONG DBYER MED DU 'CHAR BA LA SGRIB PA'I DRI MA 'KHRUD PAS YID DAG PAR BYED, 'OD GSAL PHYAG RGYA CHEN PO BSGOM PA LA DBANG BAR BYAS, 'BRAS BU CHOS KYI SKU MNGON DU GYUR BA'I NUS PA KHYAD PAR CAN 'JOG GO ,
11043.wylie: thun mong ma yin pa gang snang kun bde stong dbyer med du 'char ba la sgrib pa'i dri ma 'khrud pas yid dag par byed, 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang bar byas, 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du gyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog go
11043.english: The unique result of this initiation is that it purifies your mind, cleaning it of a special impurity: your tendency to be blinded to the fact that every single thing which ever appears to you is a manifestation of indivisible bliss and empitness.  You are, further, now empowered to engage in practices such as the Clear Light, and the Great Seal (Tantric Mahamudra).  Finally, an extraordinary seed has been planted within you which gives you the power to attain the final goal of the Dharma body.

11140.acip: (KHYAD PAR RI BO DGE LUGS PAR KHAS CHE BA RNAMS KYANG BLA MA YI DAM CHOS SKYONG 'JAM DBYANGS KHO NA LA BSTEN PA THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I MAN NGAG GI GNAD GZHAN LA MED PA'I ZAB KHYAD ZHIG YOD PA KUN LA MI BSGRAGS PAR THUGS KYI BANG MDZOD DU BZHUGS PA MDZAD 'TSAL,)
11140.wylie: (khyad par ri bo dge lugs par khas che ba rnams kyang bla ma yi dam chos skyong 'jam dbyangs kho na la bsten pa thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi gnad gzhan la med pa'i zab khyad zhig yod pa kun la mi bsgrags par thugs kyi bang mdzod du bzhugs pa mdzad 'tshal,)
11140.english: (And more specifically, it is a crucial point of unique and personal advice that those who profess to follow the Gelukpa lineage can only take themselves to one Lama, to one Close Angel, to one Protector of the Teachings: to Gentle Voice alone.  There is a certain very deep quality to this practice, and I beg you not to reveal it easily to others: keep it I beg you there, in the treasure chest of your own heart.)

11482.acip: ,GNYIS MED THUN MONG MA YIN KHYAB PA'I SKU, ,KUN LA SNYOMS MDZAD RGYAL BA KUN GYI YAB, ,CHOS KYI DBYINGS GYUR RGYAL BA KUN GYI YUM, ,YE SHES SEMS DPA' RGYAL BA KUN GYI SRAS,
11482.wylie: gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku, ,kun la snyoms mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yab, ,chos kyi dbyings gyur rgyal ba kun gyi yum, ,ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi sras
11482.english: Your holy body is indivisible, extraordinary, and covers all things; You are the Father of all Victors, Equal towards All. You are the Mother of all Victors, the Nature of the Dharma; You are the Son of all Victors, Spiritual Warrior of Wisdom.

11520.acip: ,GNYIS MED THUN MONG MA YIN KHYAB PA'I SKU, ,KUN LA SNYOMS MDZAD RGYAL BA KUN GYI YAB, ,CHOS KYI DBYINGS GYUR RGYAL BA KUN GYI YUM, ,YE SHES SEMS DPA' RGYAL BA KUN GYI SRAS,
11520.wylie: gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku, ,kun la snyoms mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yab, ,chos kyi dbyings gyur rgyal ba kun gyi yum, ,ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi sras
11520.english: Your holy body is indivisible, extraordinary, and covers all things; You are the Father of all Victors, Equal towards All. You are the Mother of all Victors, the Nature of the Dharma; You are the Son of all Victors, Spiritual Warrior of Wisdom.

11717.acip: DE DAG GI DON MDOR BSDU NA SNYING RJE CHE BA, THEG CHEN LA MI PHYED PA'I DAD PA BRTAN PA, THEG PA THUN MONG BA DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BSTAN BCOS LEGS PAR SHES PA, GDUL BYA 'KHRID PA'I RIM PA LA SHIN TU MKHAS PA, SGO GSUM GYI NYES SPYOD BSDAMS PAS DBANG PO DUL BA STE CHOS LNGA DANG LDAN PA ZHIG BLO DANG LDAN PA'I SLOB MAS BLA MAR BYA'O,
11717.wylie: de dag gi don mdor bsdu na snying rje che ba, theg chen la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan pa, theg pa thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan bcos legs par shes pa, gdul bya 'khrid pa'i rim pa la shin tu mkhas pa, sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod bsdams pas dbang po dul ba ste chos lnga dang ldan pa zhig blo dang ldan pa'i slob mas bla mar bya'o
11717.english: We may summarize as follows the qualities to look for in a tantric Lama.  They must (1) possess great compassion, and (2) absolutely unshakable faith in the greater way.  They must be (3) highly knowledgeable in the scriptures of both the way which is shared and the way which is unique to itself. They should be (4) extremely skilled in guiding disciples along each successive step of the path, and be as well (5) "controlled in their senses," which means that they must be able to restrain themselves from negative actions in body, speech, and mind. It is a person with these five qualities, the text is saying, that a truly intelligent disciple should choose as their Lama. ***

11724.acip: GSANG SNGAGS KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I SDOM PA THOB NAS MA BTANG BA BSAM PA RANG BZHIN DU GNAS PA STE KHYAD PAR GNYIS DANG LDAN PA DGOS,
11724.wylie: gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa thob nas ma btang ba bsam pa rang bzhin du gnas pa ste khyad par gnyis dang ldan pa dgos
11724.english: For a downfall to occur, to conditions must be present.  First, the person must be someone who has received the unique vows of the secret word, and who has not given them up.  Secondly, they must be in their right mind. ***

11753.acip: SNGAGS KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BSKYED RDZOGS LA SOGS PA'I DON TSIGS BCAD GCIG TZAM YAN CHAD DU LONGS PA ZHIG BSTAN PA LA BYA'O,
11753.wylie: sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa'i don tshigs bcad gcig tsam yan chad du longs pa zhig bstan pa la bya'o
11753.english: The lines about listening to a single verse from a person refer to anything from a single verse on up; and the verse mentioned here should be one which teaches the meaning of the uncommon way, the way of the secret word--covering something like one of the two stages, of creation or completion. ***

11814.acip: DE LTAR NA DBANG BSKUR NAS SMIN PAR MA BYAS PA GSANG BA BSGRAGS PA LA MA DAD PA SKYE BA, DE LA DER 'DU SHES PA, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GSANG BA BSGRAGS PA, DE GO BA GZHAN 'DUL BA'I DGOS PA CHEN PO DANG MI LDAN PA'I CHOS DRUG TSANG NA RTZA LTUNG BDUN PA YIN NO,
11814.wylie: de ltar na dbang bskur nas smin par ma byas pa gsang ba bsgrags pa la ma dad pa skye ba, de la der 'du shes pa, thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba bsgrags pa, de go ba gzhan 'dul ba'i dgos pa chen po dang mi ldan pa'i chos drug tshang na rtsa ltung bdun pa yin no
11814.english: As such, we can say that six different conditions must all be present in order for someone to commit the seventh of the root downfalls.  (1) We must reveal secrets to a person whose heart has not yet been ripened through the process of empowerment, and (2) they must lose their faith.  (3) We must conceive of the situation properly, and (4) we must be revealing some secret which is not already shared.  (5) They must understand what we are saying to them, and  (6) there must not be any other, extraordinary purpose served by doing so: some way in which revealing the secret helps further their spiritual practice, taming them somehow. *** Geshe Tsewang Samdrup on the eighth of the root downfalls:

12003.acip: 'ON KYANG RNAL 'BYOR RGYUD DU ZHES PA PHA RGYUD DU BYAS NAS, RGYUD DER RNYED DKA' BA RNAL 'BYOR MA'I RGYUD KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I DAM TSIG CES PA'I DON DU GZUNG BAR MI BYA STE, G-YON PA'I DAM TSIG TZAM MA GTOGS PA GZHAN RNAMS PHA RGYUD DANG 'DRA BAR GSUNGS PAS SO,,
12003.wylie: 'on kyang rnal 'byor rgyud du zhes pa pha rgyud du byas nas, rgyud der rnyed dka' ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig ces pa'i don du gzung bar mi bya ste, g-yon pa'i dam tshig tsam ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams pha rgyud dang 'dra bar gsungs pas so
12003.english: One should not though consider the expression "secret teachings of deep practice" to refer to the Secret Teachings of the Father, and then call these pledges "unique to the Secret Teachings of the Woman of deep practice," pledges that are "hard to find in the Father Teachings."  And this is because all these pledges, with the exception of the one about acting to the left, are spoken here in the same way that they appear in the Father Teachings. ************

12025.acip: THOGS MED PA ZHES PA NI, GANG GIS KYANG GZHOM DU MI NUS PA'I DON DU BSHAD PAS, SNGAGS KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GRUB MTHA' LAS GZHAN DU BKRI MI NUS PA DANG ,
12025.wylie: thogs med pa zhes pa ni, gang gis kyang gzhom du mi nus pa'i don du bshad pas, sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' las gzhan du bkri mi nus pa dang
12025.english: The word "untouchable" is often explained as referring to someone who cannot be overcome by another.  The expression here means that one should reach the point where they could never be led off into any system of belief other than the unique way of the secret word.

12064.acip: GANG LA SBYIN NA SLOB MA LA NI'O, ,SLOB MA CI 'DRA BA ZHIG SNYAM NA, KHYAD PAR GNYIS DANG LDAN PA STE DANG PO NI, SANGS RGYAS DANG CHOS DANG DGE 'DUN TE DKON MCHOG GSUM LA SKYABS SU SONG BA STE SKYABS 'GRO THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I SDOM PA DANG LDAN PA'O, ,GNYIS PA NI, BSAM PA DAG PA STE SMON PA DANG 'JUG PA'I BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS RNAM PA GNYIS TSUL BZHIN DU BSKYED PA'O, ,'DIS NI SNGAGS DANG PHAR PHYIN GYI THEG PA GNYIS KYI THUN MONG BA'I LAM GYI RIM PAR LA BLO LEGS PAR SBYANGS PA LA GZHUNG 'DI 'CHANG PAR BSTAN NO,
12064.wylie: gang la sbyin na slob ma la ni'o, ,slob ma ci 'dra ba zhig snyam na, khyad par gnyis dang ldan pa ste dang po ni, sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba ste skyabs 'gro thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa dang ldan pa'o, ,gnyis pa ni, bsam pa dag pa ste smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis tshul bzhin du bskyed pa'o, ,'dis ni sngags dang phar phyin gyi theg pa gnyis kyi thun mong ba'i lam gyi rim par la blo legs par sbyangs pa la gzhung 'di 'chang par bstan no
12064.english: Who is it that we should grant this teaching on how to behave towards our Lama?  It should be granted to a worthy disciple.  And what is it that makes them worthy?  The disciple should be possessed of two characteristics. First of all, they must be someone who has already gone for shelter to the Three Jewels: to the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Community.  That is to say, they must be possessed of the unique vow of refuge. The disciple must secondly be "one of a pure heart," which means that they must have given birth, in the proper way, to both forms of the Wish for enlightenment: the Wish as a prayer, and the Wish in action. The point here that the root text of the Fifty Verses is making is that a potential disciple for its teaching must be one whose mind has been perfectly prepared, by using the steps of the path which are shared by both the way of the secret word and the way of the perfections. ***

12074.acip: DAM PA GONG MA RNAMS DAM TSIG 'DI BRGYAD KA BDE MCHOG GI DAM TSIG THUN MONG MA YIN PAR 'CHAD KYANG , G-YON PA'I KUN SPYOD MA GTOGS PA RNAL 'BYOR BLA MED PA GZHAN DANG THUN MONG BA'I BSRUNG BA'I DAM TSIG KHYAD PAR CAN YIN PAR GSUNGS SHING ,
12074.wylie: dam pa gong ma rnams dam tshig 'di brgyad ka bde mchog gi dam tshig thun mong ma yin par 'chad kyang , g-yon pa'i kun spyod ma gtogs pa rnal 'byor bla med pa gzhan dang thun mong ba'i bsrung ba'i dam tshig khyad par can yin par gsungs shing
12074.english: Holy beings of the past have given the explanation that all eight of these pledges are unique pledges in the secret teachings of Highest Bliss.  All but the pledge to act to the left though have been spoken to be special pledges that are common to the other secret teachings of the group of unsurpassed deep practice, and are to be observed in them as well.

12260.acip: DE NAS THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I DNGOS GRUB RNAMS BSGRUBS NAS LAM GYIS SA GCOD PA'I TSUL 'DI RGYUD SDE 'OG MA GSUM LA SHES DGOS KYI, RLUNG DANG BZLAS PA DANG STONG PA DANG LHA'I RNAL 'BYOR RNAMS LA GCIG DRIL BYAS PAS LAM BGROD PAR 'DOD NA MI RUNG NGO, ,ZHES GSUNGS SO,,
12260.wylie: de nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub rnams bsgrubs nas lam gyis sa gcod pa'i tshul 'di rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la shes dgos kyi, rlung dang bzlas pa dang stong pa dang lha'i rnal 'byor rnams la gcig dril byas pas lam bgrod par 'dod na mi rung ngo, ,zhes gsungs so
12260.english: With this then we reach both the shared and the unique attainments.  One should understand this particular method of working up through the path in the lower three classes of the secret teachings.  It is incorrect though to think that we travel the path in these classes by just lumping together all these different deep practices of the inner winds; the recitation of mantras; emptiness; and the Angel.

12290.acip: 'DOD MI NUS TE, SNGAGS KYI LAM MA YIN PA'I PHYIR TE, SNGAGS THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAM MA YIN PA'I PHYIR NA MA KHYAB,
12290.wylie: 'dod mi nus te, sngags kyi lam ma yin pa'i phyir te, sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i lam ma yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab
12290.english: And isn't it impossible for you to agree that they do belong to the lower classes of the secret teachings?  Because isn't it the fact that they are not paths which belong to the way of the secret word?  Because isn't it the fact that they are not paths which are unique to the way of the secret word? Our reply here is, "That last statement is true, but the rest doesn't necessarily follow from it."

12296.acip: DE NI THEG CHEN GYI LUGS SPYI DANG MI MTHUN PAS RANG LUGS SU KHAS LEN MI RUNG STE, SNGAGS RIM LAS, BDAG CAG GI STON PA 'DI NI SNGON DU SANGS RGYAS ZIN ZIN PA 'DIR 'TSANG RGYA BA'I TSUL BSTAN PAR THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GSANG BA'I RGYUD DANG DRI MED 'OD LAS KYANG GSUNGS LA, SNGAGS GZHAN NAS BSHAD PA YANG MANG BAS DE 'DRA RNAMS GSAR DU 'TSANG RGYA BA MIN PAR SPRUL PA YIN PAR BZHED PA NI SNGAGS DANG PHAR PHYIN GYI THEG PA GNYIS 'DRA'O,,ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR RO,,
12296.wylie: de ni theg chen gyi lugs spyi dang mi mthun pas rang lugs su khas len mi rung ste, sngags rim las, bdag cag gi ston pa 'di ni sngon du sangs rgyas zin zin pa 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan par thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba'i rgyud dang dri med 'od las kyang gsungs la, sngags gzhan nas bshad pa yang mang bas de 'dra rnams gsar du 'tshang rgya ba min par sprul pa yin par bzhed pa ni sngags dang phar phyin gyi theg pa gnyis 'dra'o,,zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro
12296.english: This explanation though is inconsistent with the explanation accepted in the greater way as a whole.  As the Steps on the Way of the Secret Word puts it, The fact that our Teacher had already passed into enlightenment long, long before--and that here in this life he was just pretending to pass into enlightenment--is stated in both the Book of the Unique Secret and in Immaculate Light.  Many different other kinds of explanations on this point are found in the various secret works; and so the idea that these are talking about how he emanated as passing into enlightenment, and not actually first went into enlightenment, is something which is the same in both the secret and the open teachings of the greater way.

12332.acip: BSKYED RIM GYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I SPANG BYA NI THA MAL BA'I SNANG ZHEN YIN LA, DE'I THA MAL BA'I SNANG BA NI DBANG SHES LA SNANG BA'I SNOD BCUD MIN GYI ,YID SHES LA THA MAL BA'I SNOD BCUD DU SNANG BA DE YIN NO,,
12332.wylie: bskyed rim gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i spang bya ni tha mal ba'i snang zhen yin la, de'i tha mal ba'i snang ba ni dbang shes la snang ba'i snod bcud min gyi ,yid shes la tha mal ba'i snod bcud du snang ba de yin no
12332.english: The unique form of negativity which is eliminated during the stage of creation is our tendency to see things as ordinary.  When we say that "things appear as ordinary" here, what we're talking about is not the world and its inhabitants as they appear to our sense consciousnesses, but rather the ordinary world and inhabitants which appear to the consciousness of the mind.

12505.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BDE BA RKYANG BA BSGOM PA'ANG NGO MTSAR BA'I TING NGE 'DZIN YIN PAR BSNGAGS PA MDZAD PA DANG , NYER THOB DRAN MED LA BDE STONG SBYAR BA MED PAR GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR, RGYAS PAR GSAL SGRON LAS SHES PAR BYA'O,,
12505.wylie: thun mong ma yin pa'i bde ba rkyang ba bsgom pa'ang ngo mtshar ba'i ting nge 'dzin yin par bsngags pa mdzad pa dang , nyer thob dran med la bde stong sbyar ba med par gsungs pa'i phyir, rgyas par gsal sgron las shes par bya'o
12505.english: And don't they sing the praises even of practicing the unique form of bliss by itself, saying that it is a wondrous form of one-point concentration?  Isn't it stated as well that--during the stage of attainment, where we are unconscious--we cannot join here bliss and emptiness?  For more details on these points, refer to the Lantern.

12552.acip: BDAG BYIN RLABS PA'I BSHAD PA LAS, YID LA BYED TSUL GTAM TZAM YANG RNYED DKA' BA'I DON DE SGYU LUS MA GRUB KYANG 'DI'I GDAMS NGAG PHYIN CI MA LOG PA RNYED NA DA LTA NAS GOMS PAS NAM ZHIG NA SGYU MA'I SKU 'JA' LUS RDO RJE SEMS DPA'I GO 'PHANG 'GRUB PA'I BAG CHAGS THUN MONG MA YIN PA 'JOG BYED DU SNANG BAS SHIN TU NGO MTSAR BA'I GNAS SO,,
12552.wylie: bdag byin rlabs pa'i bshad pa las, yid la byed tshul gtam tsam yang rnyed dka' ba'i don de sgyu lus ma grub kyang 'di'i gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa rnyed na da lta nas goms pas nam zhig na sgyu ma'i sku 'ja' lus rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i bag chags thun mong ma yin pa 'jog byed du snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so
12552.english: This is also described in the treatise called The Blessing of Oneself, where our Lord grants us the following holy words-- Here's the point of saying that it's a difficult thing to come across even a discussion that gets you thinking about these things.  Suppose that--even if you are unable right now to attain the body of illusion--you do come across some unmistaken instructions for doing so.  If right now you begin to habituate yourself to these teachings, then you will see that it acts to plant a unique type of mental seed which will allow you, at a certain point in the future, to actually reach the body of illusion: the rainbow body, the state of the Warrior of Diamond himself.  This is an incredible thing.

12765.acip: SNGAGS RIM LAS, DU BA LA SOGS PA'I STONG GZUGS RNAMS GONG NAS GONG DU GNAS GYUR TE, YAN LAG DRUG PA'I SKABS KYI STONG GZUGS KYI 'DOD LHA YAB YUM DU SNANG BA NI, 'BRAS BU'I RDO RJE'I SKU'I THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I NYE RGYU YIN LA, DE'I TSE NA DE LTAR SNANG BA TZAM GYI LUS DNGOS PO LA STONG GZUGS KYI SKUR SONG BA MED DE, BEMS PO'I KHAMS RNAMS MA ZAD PA'I PHYIR RO,,
12765.wylie: sngags rim las, du ba la sogs pa'i stong gzugs rnams gong nas gong du gnas gyur te, yan lag drug pa'i skabs kyi stong gzugs kyi 'dod lha yab yum du snang ba ni, 'bras bu'i rdo rje'i sku'i thun mong ma yin pa'i nye rgyu yin la, de'i tshe na de ltar snang ba tsam gyi lus dngos po la stong gzugs kyi skur song ba med de, bems po'i khams rnams ma zad pa'i phyir ro
12765.english: The Great Book on the Steps of the Way of the Secret Word also says-- The empty forms of smoke and the rest go through ever higher and higher transformations.  The appearance of the Angels of Desire, Man and Woman, in their empty form during the sixth step of the practice provides the material cause which turns into the unique body of diamond when we reach the goal.  It's not the case that, at this point, the body which is nothing more than this type of appearance does, in actuality, turn into a holy body of empty form.  This is because the components which are physical material have not yet ended.

13369.acip: MTHONG GROL LDE MIG LAS, ,SNGON 'GRO DNGOS GZHI RJES GSUM DANG PO LA, ,MTHUN MONG MTHUN MONG MIN PA'I MTHUN MONG BAR, ,DAL 'BYOR RNYED DKA' MI RTAG LAS 'BRAS DANG , ,'KHOR BA'I NYES DMIGS MTHUN MONG MA YIN PAR,
13369.wylie: mthong grol lde mig las, ,sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum dang po la, ,mthun mong mthun mong min pa'i mthun mong bar, ,dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag las 'bras dang , ,'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthun mong ma yin par
13369.english: (A selection from Freedom on Sight, the Key:) There are three: The preliminaries, the main part, And the conclusion; The first has the shared And the unique. For the shared teach The difficulty of finding Leisure and fortune, Impermanence, Actions and their consequences, And the problems of cyclic life. For the unique teach

13503.acip: DE NAS PHYI PA'I PAn+dI TA RNAMS DANG ZLA BA PHYED KYI BAR DU SGRA TSAD LUNG RIGS LA RTZOD PA BYAS, NUS PA DANG RDZU PHRUL THAMS CAD 'GRAN PAS GNAS BRTAN BSTAN PA 'DZIN PA MTHA' DAG TU RGYAL TE, RGYAL PO CHEN PO PHYOGS KYI GO CHAS PHYI NANG GNYIS KA'I PAn+dI TA THAMS CAD LA GSOL BA, NGA PHYI NANG GNYIS KA'I YON BDAG YIN PA NYE RING DANG PHYOGS CA MED, BSTAN PA DPANG DU GTZUGS PA'I PHYI NANG GNYIS KAR GYIS THAMS CAD DU GNAS BRTAN BSTAN PA 'DZIN PA CHEN PO SUS KYANG THUB PA MED PAR PHYOGS THAMS CAD DU RGYAL BA'I RNAM THAR LA THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I DAD PA SKYES SO GSUNGS,,
13503.wylie: de nas phyi pa'i paN+Di ta rnams dang zla ba phyed kyi bar du sgra tshad lung rigs la rtsod pa byas, nus pa dang rdzu phrul thams cad 'gran pas gnas brtan bstan pa 'dzin pa mtha' dag tu rgyal te, rgyal po chen po phyogs kyi go chas phyi nang gnyis ka'i paN+Di ta thams cad la gsol ba, nga phyi nang gnyis ka'i yon bdag yin pa nye ring dang phyogs ca med, bstan pa dpang du gtsugs pa'i phyi nang gnyis kar gyis thams cad du gnas brtan bstan pa 'dzin pa chen po sus kyang thub pa med par phyogs thams cad du rgyal ba'i rnam thar la thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa skyes so gsungs
13503.english: He then debates, for another half a month, the subject of classical languages and the art of reasoning with the non-Buddhist sages, utilizing both scriptural authority and sheer logic.  They engage in contests too of magical power and miracles.  The Elder who Upholds the Teachings wins over them all. The high king of this land, whose name is Invincible Armor, then addresses all the sages, both the Buddhist and non-Buddhist:  "I am a monarch who chooses to donate support to both Buddhist and non-Buddhist groups; I never discriminate between the two.  But I must say that we have all watched here how both Buddhist and non-Buddhist sages, as they attempt to bear witness to their separate beliefs, have been completely unable to prevail over this great man, the Elder who Upholds the Teachings.  And so I personally have come to feel some unique kind of faith in his mighty deeds, as he overcame every single opponent." His Life as a Lion of Debate

13739.acip: , ,RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD KYI SGRUB THABS THUN MONG MA YIN PA BDE CHEN NYE LAM ZHES BYA BA BZHUGS SO,,
13739.wylie: ,rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nA ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa bde chen nye lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so
13739.english: Herein Contained is the Short Path to Great Bliss, a Unique Method for Becoming The Holy Angel of Diamond, and for Reaching The Heaven of Naropa

13748.acip: BOD YUL DU DPAL LDAN SA SKYAB YAB SRAS KYI SNYAN BRGYUD GSER CHOS BCU GSUM GYI NANG TSAN, KHAMS GSUM CHOS KYI RGYAL PO TZONG KHA PA CHEN PO'I THUGS LA GAB PA'I SPAS CHOS THUN MONG MA YIN PA,
13748.wylie: bod yul du dpal ldan sa skyab yab sras kyi snyan brgyud gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan, khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i thugs la gab pa'i spas chos thun mong ma yin pa
13748.english: In Tibet, this instruction is one of the thirteen Dharmas of Gold, which were passed down orally from the glorious Father and Sons of the Sakya.   And it was a very personal, unique, and private hidden Dharma held deep in the heart of the Great Tsongkapa, King of the Dharma of all Three Realms.

13749.acip: N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD DU GRAGS PA RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA'I SGRUB THABS THUN MONG MA YIN PA LTAR NYAMS SU LEN PA'I TSUL LAG TU BLANG BDE BAR 'GOD PA LA,
13749.wylie: nA ro mkha' spyod du grags pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul lag tu blang bde bar 'god pa la
13749.english: Here I will set forth a practice which follows this unique method for becoming the Holy Angel of Diamond, and which is easily carried out.

13751.acip: DE'I STENG DU 'DI NYID KYI SINDHU RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR DU BYIN RLABS ZAB MO PHYI NANG GSANG BA'I RDO RJE BTZUN MO NGO 'PHROD NGES SU LEGS PAR MNOS TE, THUN MONG DANG, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I MAN NGAG ZHAL SHES RNAMS DANG BCAS PA GSANG CHEN SLOB BSHAD PA'I PHYAG BZHES 'KHRUL MED LTAR THOB NAS NYAMS SU LEN PA'I RIM PA LA GNYIS,
13751.wylie: de'i steng du 'di nyid kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs zab mo phyi nang gsang ba'i rdo rje btsun mo ngo 'phrod nges su legs par mnos te, thun mong dang, thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag zhal shes rnams dang bcas pa gsang chen slob bshad pa'i phyag bzhes 'khrul med ltar thob nas nyams su len pa'i rim pa la gnyis
13751.english: On top of all this, he must have entered the Sindura world of this very practice, and there been granted fully a deep blessing such that he will surely meet the inner, outer, and secret Queen of the Diamond.  Finally, he must have received instruction, in keeping with the infallible tradition of the Great Secret, on both the shared and unique advices of this practice, along with the various points that can only be conveyed in private.

13883.acip: (PAR BSAM, DBANG BZHI LEN TSUL THUN MONG MA YIN PA NI ZHAL LAS SHES PAR BYA'O,)
13883.wylie: (par bsam, dbang bzhi len tshul thun mong ma yin pa ni zhal las shes par bya'o,)
13883.english: (There is also an uncommon way you can take the Four Empowerments; this you can learn only in private.  Now continue:)

13924.acip: ('DI NI LUGS 'DI'I ZAB GNAD THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I MAN NGAG MTHAR THUG PA YI GE RNYING PA RNAMS SU SA BON TZAM LAS MI GSAL BA BLA MA'I ZHAL GYI MAN NGAG LA BRTEN NAS SHIN TU GO BDE BAR BKOD PA YIN PAS GCES PAR ZUNGS SHIG)
13924.wylie: ('di ni lugs 'di'i zab gnad thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag mthar thug pa yi ge rnying pa rnams su sa bon tsam las mi gsal ba bla ma'i zhal gyi man ngag la brten nas shin tu go bde bar bkod pa yin pas gces par zungs shig)
13924.english: (This the ultimate instruction for this practice; profound, crucial, and unique.  Aside from hints it is a teaching which is never fully revealed in the ancient texts.  What I have written here comes from the personal advices of our Lama tradition, and is very easy to follow.  Thus I ask you to cherish and keep it well.)

13996.acip: (BCU PA BSAM GYIS MI KHYAB PA'I RNAL 'BYOR LA GNYIS LAS, THUN MONG MA YIN PA NI KHRID LAS BYUNG BA LTAR NYAMS SU BLANG, THUN MONG BA NI,)
13996.wylie: (bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las, thun mong ma yin pa ni khrid las byung ba ltar nyams su blang, thun mong ba ni,)
13996.english: (Number ten is the Practice of the Inconceivable, and it has two parts.  You should practice the one called "unique" according to the instructions you have received.  To do the "common" one, imagine this:)

14099.acip: (DE LTAR RJE BTZUN RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD KYI SGRUB THABS THUN MONG MA YIN PA BDE CHEN NYE LAM ZHES BYA BA 'DI NI LAM 'DI NYAMS SU LEN PA'I RNAL 'BYOR BA DAG GI RGYUN GYI RNAL 'BYOR DANG, MTSAMS BSNYEN SOGS KYI SKABS NYAMS SU LEN BDE BA'I RIM PA KHO NAR SGRIGS KYI, DKYIL 'KHOR SGRUB MCHOD DANG 'BREL BA'I SKABS DKYIL CHOG DANG SBRAGS NAS NYAMS SU LEN TSUL GYI KHYAD PAR PHYED PAR BYA'O, ,)
14099.wylie: (de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nA ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa bde chen nye lam zhes bya ba 'di ni lam 'di nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor ba dag gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang, mtshams bsnyen sogs kyi skabs nyams su len bde ba'i rim pa kho nar sgrigs kyi, dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i skabs dkyil chog dang sbrags nas nyams su len tshul gyi khyad par phyed par bya'o, ,)
14099.english: (This then is the Short Path to Great Bliss, a Unique Method for Becoming the Holy Angel of the Diamond, and Reaching the Heaven of Naropa.  I have written it only to provide some steps that are easy to carry out during those occasions when persons who usually follow this path perform their regular practice, or when they do a retreat or similar activity.  You should however draw a distinction between this and the method of practice connected to the Ritual for the Secret World, which is to be carried out on occasions that relate to the Offering to Reach the Secret World.)

14105.acip: SNGON 'GRO DNGOS GZHI RJES GSUM DANG PO LA, , THUN MONG THUN MONG MIN PA'I THUN MONG BAR, , DAL 'BYOR RHE DKA' MI RTAG LAS 'BRAS DANG, , 'KHOR BA'I NYES DMIGS THUN MONG MA YIN PAR, ,
14105.wylie: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum dang po la, , thun mong thun mong min pa'i thun mong bar, , dal 'byor rhe dka' mi rtag las 'bras dang, , 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thun mong ma yin par,
14105.english: There are three: The preliminaries, the main part, And the conclusion; The first has the shared And the unique. For the shared teach The difficulty of finding Leisure and fortune, Impermanence, Actions and their consequences, And the problems of cyclic life. For the unique teach

14348.acip: DE DAG GI SKABS SU KHAS BLANGS PA'I DAM SDOM TSUL BZHIN DU BSRUNG ZHING, BSKYED RIM RNAL 'BYOR BCU GCIG DANG, RDZOGS RIM RTZA DBU MA, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I MAN NGAG ZHAL SHES DANG BCAS PA GSANG CHEN SLOB BSHAD PA'I PHYAG BZHES JI LTA BA BZHIN GYI KHRID RGYUN LEGS PAR THOB PA ZHIG DANG,
14348.wylie: de dag gi skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam sdom tshul bzhin du bsrung zhing, bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang, rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma, thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag zhal shes dang bcas pa gsang chen slob bshad pa'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin gyi khrid rgyun legs par thob pa zhig dang
14348.english: The person must also be keeping properly the pledges and vows that they agreed to upon these occasions.  They must further be a person who has received properly the lineage teachings, according to the tradition of learning and explaining the Great Secret: they must have received the teachings of the lineage on the Eleven Yogas of the stage of creation; those on the practice of the central channel in the stage of completion; and also the unique advices, along with those instructions that are only conferred in private.

14357.acip: BLA MED KYI RGYUD SDE CHEN PO'I DKYIL 'KHOR DU DBANG BZHI RNAM PAR DAG PA THOB CING, LHAG PAR 'DI NYID KYI DBANG BZHI BYIN RLABS MTSAN NYID TSANG BA THOB PA NAS BZUNG, DBANG BZHI BYIN RLABS KYI ZHAL SHES THUN MONG MA YIN PA'AM, THUN MONG BA GANG RUNG 'CHAG MED DU NYAMS SU BLANGS PA'O,
14357.wylie: bla med kyi rgyud sde chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rnam par dag pa thob cing, lhag par 'di nyid kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs mtshan nyid tshang ba thob pa nas bzung, dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi zhal shes thun mong ma yin pa'am, thun mong ba gang rung 'chag med du nyams su blangs pa'o
14357.english: This means that everything must have been practiced in a continual stream over the years, without any break.  The pure four empowerments must have been received in a secret world belonging to the great Unsurpassed group of secret teachings.  Most especially, the four empowerments of this particular practice, complete in every requirement, must have been received.  And everything from here on up must be unbroken too, all the way to the private advices on the blessing of the four powers (which can be the unique advices, those that are shared, or both).

14451.acip: NYAL LUGS PHYI MA LTAR BYED NA STONG NYID KYI NGANG LA NYAL BA THUGS KYI DAG PA STE 'CHI BA SBYONG, LHA SKUR LDANG BA SKU DAG PA STE SKYE BA SBYONG, BDUD RTZI MYANG BA 'OD DPAG MED GSUNG GI DAG PA STE LONGS SKU 'GRUB PA'I SMIN BYED DANG, 'DI'I DAG PA SBYOR TSUL SHIN TU LEGS TE 'OD GSAL DE LAS GZUGS SKUR BZHENGS TE, BZLAS BRJOD SOGS BYED PAS SO,,
14451.wylie: nyal lugs phyi ma ltar byed na stong nyid kyi ngang la nyal ba thugs kyi dag pa ste 'chi ba sbyong, lha skur ldang ba sku dag pa ste skye ba sbyong, bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med gsung gi dag pa ste longs sku 'grub pa'i smin byed dang, 'di'i dag pa sbyor tshul shin tu legs te 'od gsal de las gzugs skur bzhengs te, bzlas brjod sogs byed pas so
14451.english: Sleeping in the latter of the two ways--that is, dropping off to sleep within the void--is also the purity of Her holy mind, and acts to transform the state of death.  Getting out of bed in Her sacred form is the purity of Her holy body, and functions to transform the state of rebirth. Partaking of the nectar is the purity of the sacred speech of Limitless Light, and serves to ripen our minds for achieving the body of paradise.  This way of explaining what the three purities refer to is a very fine one, since we should be getting up out of a state of the clear light, rising in the holy body of an enlightened form, and then undertaking our various practices, such as recitation. The Categories of Practice

14460.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PAR, ,SKYABS SEMS RDOR SEMS BLA MA'I RNAL 'BYOR KHRID,
14460.wylie: thun mong ma yin par, ,skyabs sems rdor sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor khrid
14460.english: For the unique teach Refuge, the Wish, Diamond Warrior, And Lama Practice.]

14461.acip: LAM LOG PA LAS KHYAD PAR DU BYA BA SKYABS 'GRO, DMAN PA LAS KHYAD PAR DU BYA BA SEMS BSKYED, 'GAL RKYEN SDIG SGRIB SBYONG BA RDOR SEMS BSGOM BZLAS, MTHUN RKYEN TSOGS GSOG PA BLA MA'I RNAL 'BYOR DANG MAndAL GYI KHRID DE SNGON 'GRO KHRID CHEN BZHI PO SPYI DANG MI MTHUN PA GO RIM DE LTAR DU BYED PA 'DI'I THUN MONG MA YIN PA STE,
14461.wylie: lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro, dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed, 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdor sems bsgom bzlas, mthun rkyen tshogs gsog pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang maNDal gyi khrid de sngon 'gro khrid chen bzhi po spyi dang mi mthun pa go rim de ltar du byed pa 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa ste
14461.english: There are four different sets of instructions here.  First there is (1) the practice of going for shelter, which is what distinguishes this path from wrong paths.  Then comes (2) the Wish for enlightenment, which distinguishes this path from lower ones.  Next is (3) the practice of meditation and recitation on the Warrior of Diamond, which functions to clean us of the negative deeds and obstacles which would work against our practice.  And then finally there is (4) the Yoga of the Lama, where we seek to amass good karma which will support our practice.  This last is accompanied by the practice of offering the mandala. When we say that these are "unique" preliminaries, what we mean is that they are not the same as the four great instructions on the preliminary practices that we normally speak of.  Doing them in the order just stated is unique to this particular tradition of practice.

14497.acip: NANG PA'I KHYAD CHOS THUN MONG MA YIN PA SKYABS 'GRO, SEMS BSKYED, LTA BA GSUM GYIS 'DON DGOS, RANG RES CHOS NYAMS LEN GYI 'GO TSUGS MI TSUGS MI RTAG PA'I RTOGS PA RGYUD LA SKYES MA SKYES LA RAG LAS,
14497.wylie: nang pa'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa skyabs 'gro, sems bskyed, lta ba gsum gyis 'don dgos, rang res chos nyams len gyi 'go tshugs mi tshugs mi rtag pa'i rtogs pa rgyud la skyes ma skyes la rag las
14497.english: It is necessary for us to distinguish this practice from others with those attitudes that are unique to Buddhism: going for refuge, developing the Wish, and correct view.  The question of whether you and I have even begun to practice the Dharma depends on whether or not we have been able to develop the realization of our own impermanence, our own death.

14547.acip: YANG SKYABS SEMS LA NGES 'BYUNG BYANG SEMS GNYIS KYANG TSANG STE, NGES 'BYUNG SKYABS 'GRO'I KHONGS DANG, BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS NI SEMS BSKYED KYI KHONGS SU 'DU GSUNGS, DE NAS THAL MO SBYAR TE, BLA MA DANG DKON MCHOG RIN PO CHE ZHES SOGS KYIS SKYABS GSOL BYED PA GSANG CHEN SLOB BSHAD PA DAG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I PHYAG SROL YIN PAS LNGA PA CHEN POS LAM RIM 'JAM DPAL ZHAL LUNG LA'ANG SBYAR BAR MDZAD,
14547.wylie: yang skyabs sems la nges 'byung byang sems gnyis kyang tshang ste, nges 'byung skyabs 'gro'i khongs dang, byang chub kyi sems ni sems bskyed kyi khongs su 'du gsungs, de nas thal mo sbyar te, bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che zhes sogs kyis skyabs gsol byed pa gsang chen slob bshad pa dag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag srol yin pas lnga pa chen pos lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung la'ang sbyar bar mdzad
14547.english: Our Lama finally noted that this recitation for taking refuge and developing the Wish for Buddhahood includes, complete, the principal paths of renunciation and the Wish.  Renunciation is incorporated into the part for taking refuge, and the Wish for enlightenment is incorporated in the part for developing the Wish. Now join your palms at your breast and recite the lines that begin with "I bow down and I go for refuge to my Lama."  This act of refuge and supplication is a unique custom among those who teach and study the Great Secret; and this is why the Great Fifth included it in His work on the steps to the path entitled Word of the Glorious Gentle One.

14835.acip: SA LUGS LA BLA RNAL THUN MONG BA MA GTOGS THUN MONG MIN PA SNYAN BRGYUD KHO NAR MDZAD PAS DNGUL CHU'I SGRUB THABS SU THUN MONG BA MDZAD, DE'ANG BLA MA DPA' BO RDO RJE CHOS SU BSKYED PA THUN MONG BA, SANGS RGYAS RDO RJE CHOS SU BSKYED PA THUN MONG MA YIN PA YIN, DE GNYIS NGO BO GCIG CING, BLA MA LA SANGS RGYAS DNGOS KYI 'DU SHES YOD NA RNAM PA SANGS RGYAS SU BSGOM MA BSGOMS LA KHYAD MED KYANG,
14835.wylie: sa lugs la bla rnal thun mong ba ma gtogs thun mong min pa snyan brgyud kho nar mdzad pas dngul chu'i sgrub thabs su thun mong ba mdzad, de'ang bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos su bskyed pa thun mong ba, sangs rgyas rdo rje chos su bskyed pa thun mong ma yin pa yin, de gnyis ngo bo gcig cing, bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes yod na rnam pa sangs rgyas su bsgom ma bsgoms la khyad med kyang
14835.english: According to the Sakya tradition the unique practice of the Lama, as opposed to the shared one, can only be passed down orally, and so in Ngulchu's ritual for reaching the Angel he has used the shared one.  Now producing your Lama as Dharma of Diamond the Warrior is the shared practice, and producing Her or Him as Dharma of Diamond the Buddha is the unique practice.  In fact these two beings have one and the same nature; and if you see your Lama as the Buddha himself, it makes no difference whether you meditate on Him in the form of the Buddha or not.

14877.acip: LHA GZHAN DU MOS PA LAS RDO RJE CHOS SU MOS NA DE NYID GSUNG RDO RJE 'OD DPAG MED KYI RANG BZHIN YIN PA'I PHYIR DE GDUL BYA'I RGYUD LA PHAN 'DOGS PA'I RTEN 'BREL YOD CING, SANGS RGYAS RDO RJE CHOS DANG DPA' BO RDO RJE CHOS SU BSGOM TSUL MTHUN MONG DANG MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BZHED TSUL MANG YANG,
14877.wylie: lha gzhan du mos pa las rdo rje chos su mos na de nyid gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir de gdul bya'i rgyud la phan 'dogs pa'i rten 'brel yod cing, sangs rgyas rdo rje chos dang dpa' bo rdo rje chos su bsgom tshul mthun mong dang mthun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed tshul mang yang
14877.english: If you visualize your Lama as Diamond Dharma rather than as some other Angel, it is auspicious for Them being able to benefit the minds of Their students, because Diamond Dharma is of the nature of Limitless Light (Amitabha), the diamond of enlightened speech.  You can meditate on your Lama as Diamond Dharma the Buddha or as Diamond Dharma the Warrior, and you can do so in the regular way or in the unique way.  There are many different ways of explaining how to do this.

14892.acip: RGYAS PAR NA, MA RGYUD BDE MCHOG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I RIG MA BCU DRUG GIS MCHOD, RGYAS PA 'DIR RIG MA DRUG KYANG 'DU BAS DE DAG GI PHYAG RGYA NI,
14892.wylie: rgyas par na, ma rgyud bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod, rgyas pa 'dir rig ma drug kyang 'du bas de dag gi phyag rgya ni
14892.english: If you wish to perform an extensive offering, you can do so with the sixteen Enlightened Women who are unique to the practice of Highest Bliss in the secret teachings of the Wife.  Since the six Enlightened Women are included in the extensive offering, I will describe the gestures of offering together.

14907.acip: SNGAGS LUGS KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS NI BDE STONG GI YE SHES YIN PAS 'DIR MCHOD PA THAMS CAD KYIS MCHOD YUL GYI THUGS RGYUD LA BDE STONG GI YE SHES KHYAD PAR CAN BSKYED PAR BSAM DGOS,
14907.wylie: sngags lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni bde stong gi ye shes yin pas 'dir mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod yul gyi thugs rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can bskyed par bsam dgos
14907.english: The Wish for enlightenment which is unique to the tradition of the secret word is the wisdom of bliss and emptiness.  Therefore you must think to yourself that all the various offerings cause a very exceptional form of the wisdom of bliss and emptiness to rise up in the hearts of all the Beings to whom the offerings are being presented.

14952.acip: BEM RIG DBYE TSUL YONGS GRAGS MIN PA'I SNYAN BRGYUD THUN MONG MA YIN PA ZHIG KYANG YOD,
14952.wylie: bem rig dbye tshul yongs grags min pa'i snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa zhig kyang yod
14952.english: There is also a very unique method, come to us through oral tradition, for how we tear the mind from the body; it is quite different from the way we have normally heard described.

14989.acip: DPAL LDAN SA SKYA PA RNAMS KYIS DBANG BZHI'I MAN NGAG SHOG DRIL DU MDZAD, ZHAL SHES KYI DBANG BZHI LEN TSUL BKA' RGYA CAN NI SA LUGS LA MA GRAGS PA'I DGE LDAN SNYAN BRGYUD KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA YIN PAS DE LTAR LEN TSUL RGYAS PA ZHIG KHO BOS BDE MCHOG LA SBYAR TE BRTZAMS PA LTAR BYA CHOG GSUNGS,
14989.wylie: dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams kyis dbang bzhi'i man ngag shog dril du mdzad, zhal shes kyi dbang bzhi len tshul bka' rgya can ni sa lugs la ma grags pa'i dge ldan snyan brgyud kyi thun mong ma yin pa yin pas de ltar len tshul rgyas pa zhig kho bos bde mchog la sbyar te brtsams pa ltar bya chog gsungs
14989.english: The glorious Lamas of the Sakya tradition have written the advices for the four empowerments down in scrolls.  The sealed teachings for how to take on the four empowerments in the way of private instruction though are something not known among the Sakyas; they are something which is unique to the oral tradition of the Virtuous Ones.  Our Lama told us that He had incorporated these teachings into a very detailed version of how to accept the empowerments, one that He had composed for the ritual of Highest Bliss, and that we could follow it here as well.

14997.acip: BLA MA'I DRUNG DU 'DI GA'I SINDH'U RA'I DBANG BZHI BYIN RLABS NOS BA NAS BZUNG 'DI'I GZHUNG DU GSAL BA'I DBANG BZHI LEN TSUL BSDUS PA THUN MONG BA'AM, ZHAL SHES DBANG BZHI RGYAS PA LEN TSUL THUN MONG MA YIN PA GANG RUNG ZHIG CHAG MED NYAMS SU LEN NUS NA GONG DU ZHUS PA LTAR DBANG GI CHU BO MA NUB PA ZHES BYIN RLABS KYI RGYUN MI NYAMS PA'I GNAD CHE BA YOD GSUNGS,
14997.wylie: bla ma'i drung du 'di ga'i sindhU ra'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs nos ba nas bzung 'di'i gzhung du gsal ba'i dbang bzhi len tshul bsdus pa thun mong ba'am, zhal shes dbang bzhi rgyas pa len tshul thun mong ma yin pa gang rung zhig chag med nyams su len nus na gong du zhus pa ltar dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa zhes byin rlabs kyi rgyun mi nyams pa'i gnad che ba yod gsungs
14997.english: Suppose you are able to make it all a part of your life; first you are granted the blessings of the four empowerments for this Angel in Her Sindhura world.  You keep to all Her practices from there on up, and you follow without fail one of the two ways of accepting the four Empowerments: either the regular, briefer one described in the scriptures of Her way; or else the one with the more detailed empowerments--the unique one--which you learn privately.  This has, said our Lama, a very vital importance.  This is what keeps the stream of the blessing from ever being lost; and this is what I was speaking about above, when I said that the stream of the empowerment should never have run dry. Third of the Private Instructions: Bringing the Lama Inside

15074.acip: THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAM LA BLO RIM GYIS SBYANGS NAS BSKYED RIM GYI RTOGS PA SNE ZIN SKYES PA NI SNGAGS SKYES KYI RNAL 'BYOR MA STE PHYI MA'O, SA LUGS LA LAS LAS SKYES PA DANG, RIGS LAS SKYES PA'I THA SNYAD KYANG MDZAD,
15074.wylie: thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam la blo rim gyis sbyangs nas bskyed rim gyi rtogs pa sne zin skyes pa ni sngags skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma ste phyi ma'o, sa lugs la las las skyes pa dang, rigs las skyes pa'i tha snyad kyang mdzad
15074.english: Angels born of the secret word are people who have trained their minds step-by-step in the open and secret teachings and who have a strong foundation in creation-stage realizations; these are considered the last among the Angels.  In the Sakya system, they are sometimes called "Angels born from ritual" or "Angels born of the family." The Blessings of the Three Angels

15080.acip: BCAD DON NYAMS SU LEN PA SEMS 'DZIN GYI BYA BA LA, THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I SNGON 'GRO BRGYAD PO SONG NAS, DNGOS GZHI LA BSKYED RDZOGS GNYIS LAS,
15080.wylie: bcad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba la, thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro brgyad po song nas, dngos gzhi la bskyed rdzogs gnyis las
15080.english: Now we will discuss how you must put all of the points of this path into practice by actually meditating on them.  We have already described the eight shared and unique preliminaries, and have reached the main practice.  The main practice has two divisions: the stage of creation and the stage of completion.

15104.acip: BSAM MI KHYAB CES PA STONG NYID LA ZER BA DANG, ZUNG 'JUG LA'ANG 'JUG PA YIN, 'DI'I THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I MING 'DOGS SHOR BA YIN ZHES LCANG SKYAS GSUNGS PA YANG RJES GZHIG GI SDUD RIM BYAS NAS SNYING KHAR RTZA RLUNG RNAMS 'DU BA DANG DE LA BRTEN NAS DBU MAR RLUNG ZHUGS GNAS THIM GSUM SOGS 'BYUNG BAS RDZOGS RIM GYI SMIN BYED KHYAD PAR CAN DU 'GYUR LA, PHYI MA NI PHYI'I MKHA' SPYOD TZAM DON DU GNYER BA YIN NO,
15104.wylie: bsam mi khyab ces pa stong nyid la zer ba dang, zung 'jug la'ang 'jug pa yin, 'di'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ming 'dogs shor ba yin zhes lcang skyas gsungs pa yang rjes gzhig gi sdud rim byas nas snying khar rtsa rlung rnams 'du ba dang de la brten nas dbu mar rlung zhugs gnas thim gsum sogs 'byung bas rdzogs rim gyi smin byed khyad par can du 'gyur la, phyi ma ni phyi'i mkha' spyod tsam don du gnyer ba yin no
15104.english: The word "inconceivable" refers to emptiness, and also to the final Union.  Master Changkya also mentions that "this practice has come to be spoken of in two different versions, the common one and the unique one."  When you do the step of withdrawing the visualization by dissolving it, you withdraw the winds and channels into the heart.  Due to that, the winds enter, stay, and dissolve into the central channel; among other things.  This is a practice that acts in a very special way to get you ready for the steps of the completion stage.  The latter version is one for people who are seeking only to reach the outer heaven.

15231.acip: DE NAS GZHAN DON DU CHOS KYI SKU LAS GZUGS KYI SKUR LDANG BAR BYA'O SNYAM PA'I 'PHEN PA BYAS LA, DE LTAR SNANG BA THAMS CAD STONG PA'I NGANG LAS
15231.wylie: de nas gzhan don du chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur ldang bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa byas la, de ltar snang ba thams cad stong pa'i ngang las
15231.english: Then make a resolution that--for the sake of others--you will rise out of the Dharma Body into the Form Body.  And so first we bring to mind a state of emptiness where everything that normally appears to us is gone.

15385.acip: RNA BA GA-YAS GA-YON GNYIS KYI RDO RJE'I BAR NAS RE RE YOD PA THABS BDE BA CHE PO MTSON, THOD SKAM GYI RTZER RNAM SNANG DBUS SU YOD PA'I RGYAL BA RIGS LNGA MTHA' PA TRAS BSKOR BA'I RTZE PHRAN 'PHANG SOR LNGA YOD PA RE RE'ANG RIGS LNGA'I BDAG NYID YIN PA MTSON PA DANG, CHOS SKU LAS GZUGS SKUR BZHENGS PA'ANG MTSON,
15385.wylie: rna ba ga-yas ga-yon gnyis kyi rdo rje'i bar nas re re yod pa thabs bde ba che po mtshon, thod skam gyi rtser rnam snang dbus su yod pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga mtha' pa tras bskor ba'i rtse phran 'phang sor lnga yod pa re re'ang rigs lnga'i bdag nyid yin pa mtshon pa dang, chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs pa'ang mtshon
15385.english: Between the diamond bolts at Her left and right ears there is another skull each, which represents method: great bliss.  On top of each dry skull, in the center, is the Angel named Appearances; and around Him are the Buddhas of the five families circled on the outside like an endless knot, tiny points around the main point, five fingerwidths high, each of the other points representing a combination of all five of these Buddhas.  This also represents the fact that the Form Body rises out of the Dharma Body.

15600.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PAR PHYOGS BCU'I DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA RNAMS KYIS KHRUS GSOL BAS NA 'DIR DE BZHIN GSHEGS KUN ZHES BYUNG , LHA YI CHU NI ZHES PA'ANG THUN MONG BAR LHA'I CHU BO GANG+G'A SOGS DANG , 'DIR BLA MED THUN MONG MIN PA LTAR NA, DON DAM PA'I LHA'AM NGES DON GYI LHA NI BDE STONG GI YE SHES YIN PAS,
15600.wylie: thun mong ma yin par phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis khrus gsol bas na 'dir de bzhin gshegs kun zhes byung , lha yi chu ni zhes pa'ang thun mong bar lha'i chu bo gang+gA sogs dang , 'dir bla med thun mong min pa ltar na, don dam pa'i lha'am nges don gyi lha ni bde stong gi ye shes yin pas
15600.english: In the path though which is unique to the secret teachings, it was the Buddhas, "those Who Have Gone That Way," living in all ten directions of space who came and performed the offering of bathing Him.  As such, the line here says "all Who've Gone That Way." The phrase "Angel waters" or "water of the gods� can also be read two ways.  In the path which is shared it would refer to the holy waters of the Ganges River and so on.  Here in the unsurpassed form of the path which is unique, the  "Angel" or  "god" is the ultimate one, the actual one: the wisdom of bliss and voidness.

15616.acip: PHAR PHYIN THEG PAR MED PA'I GSANG SNGAGS KYI KHYAD CHOS THUN MONG MA YIN PA, 'THOB BYA 'BRAS DUS KYI YONGS DAG BZHI DANG RNAM PA MTHUN PA'I RGYU LAM DU BYED PA LAM DUS SU SLOB DGOS PAS NA,
15616.wylie: phar phyin theg par med pa'i gsang sngags kyi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa, 'thob bya 'bras dus kyi yongs dag bzhi dang rnam pa mthun pa'i rgyu lam du byed pa lam dus su slob dgos pas na
15616.english: We must then train ourselves in this feature which is so unique to the way of the secret word, something never found in the way of the perfections.  Here while we are still on the path we must use the causes, practices which are consistent with the four total purities, as a way to attain our goals: these same purities as they exist once we have already reached the result of the path.

15624.acip: RTAGS BSGYUR TSUL 'DI KYE RDOR GYI RGYUD NAS GSUNGS PA'I MAN NGAG YIN, DE YANG BUD MED KYI GZUGS SPONG TSUL DMIGS PA BSGYUR NAS SPONG BA YIN GYI, RTEN BSGYUR BA MA YIN LA, DE YANG ZHAL GCIG PHYAG GNYIS PA DANG , SKU MDOG NAG PA DANG , GRI THOD 'DZIN PA SPONG BA MA YIN GYI, LHA MOR 'JOG PA'I RTAGS THUN MONG MA YIN PA NU MA RGYAS PA DANG , BHA GA'I RNAM PA BSGYUR BA'O,,
15624.wylie: rtags bsgyur tshul 'di kye rdor gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i man ngag yin, de yang bud med kyi gzugs spong tshul dmigs pa bsgyur nas spong ba yin gyi, rten bsgyur ba ma yin la, de yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang , sku mdog nag pa dang , gri thod 'dzin pa spong ba ma yin gyi, lha mor 'jog pa'i rtags thun mong ma yin pa nu ma rgyas pa dang , bha ga'i rnam pa bsgyur ba'o
15624.english: The process of changing sexes here is an instruction spoken in the secret teachings of Lo Diamond.  When you relinquish the form of a woman, by the way, you do so in your visualization; it's not that your body actually changes.  And it's not that you give up the various characteristics of having one head and two arms, of having a dark color and holding the chopknife and skull.  Rather, what transform are the unique features that identify you as a female Angel: your breasts with their erect nipples, and your bhaga.

15646.acip: LUS DKYIL LA THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA GNYIS YOD PA LAS, THUN MONG BA NI AIN+D+RA BHU TI NAS BRGYUD PA'I PHAG MO ZHAL GNYIS MA'I LUS DKYIL 'DIR BLANGS PA DANG , THUN MONG MA YIN PA NI 'DI YIN NO,,
15646.wylie: lus dkyil la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis yod pa las, thun mong ba ni ain+d+ra bhu ti nas brgyud pa'i phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i lus dkyil 'dir blangs pa dang , thun mong ma yin pa ni 'di yin no
15646.english: There are two forms of the practice of the secret world of the body: the regular form and the unique form.  The regular form is the one which is performed in the teachings of the Two-Headed Sow, which has come down in a lineage from Indrabhuti.  The unique form is the one that we find here in this teaching.

15761.acip: MTSAMS BZHI'I BDUD RTZIS GANG BA'I BUM THOD BRTZEGS PA LAS GZUGS RDO RJE MA SOGS 'DOD YON GYI LHA MO BZHI SPROS TE RANG NYID LA MCHOD PAR BYED,
15761.wylie: mtshams bzhi'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum thod brtsegs pa las gzugs rdo rje ma sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mo bzhi spros te rang nyid la mchod par byed
15761.english: These Women take up as well, from the four corners, vases of skulls filled with the nectar of deathlessness; and from them fly forth the Four Angels of the objects of the senses -- the Diamond Lady of Forms and the rest -- who then make offerings to You.

15764.acip: DE'I DON NI, SNGON STON PA SANGS RGYAS SKU 'KHRUNGS PA'I TSE MDO LUGS GDUL BYA THUN MONG BA'I SNANG NGOR LHA KLU SOGS KYIS SKU KHRUS GSOL BA DANG, GDUL BYA THUN MONG MA YIN PA SNGAGS LUGS LA PHYOGS BCU'I DE BZHIN GSHEGS PAS DBANG BSKUR BA DPER MDZAD NAS DE BZHIN DU BDAG GIS KYANG BDE STONG GNYIS SU MED PA'I YE SHES SAM, DON DAM PA'I LHA BUM CHU'I RNAM PAR SHAR BA'I CHUS KHYOD LA KHRUS BGYI'O,,
15764.wylie: de'i don ni, sngon ston pa sangs rgyas sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe mdo lugs gdul bya thun mong ba'i snang ngor lha klu sogs kyis sku khrus gsol ba dang, gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa sngags lugs la phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pas dbang bskur ba dper mdzad nas de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sam, don dam pa'i lha bum chu'i rnam par shar ba'i chus khyod la khrus bgyi'o
15764.english: Let's describe these lines a bit.  When in days gone by our Teacher, Lord Buddha, took His precious birth in this world, then according to the open teachings -- which reflect what common disciples perceived at the time -- certain worldly gods and serpent beings and other such people came and presented Him the offering of a bathing.  According to the teachings of the secret word though -- which reflects what unique disciples saw at that time -- the Ones Gone Thus living in every single corner of the universe came and bestowed an empowerment upon Him.  And now, "just as They" for example "did then, we bathe you in the wisdom of the indivisible pair of bliss and emptiness" -- or you could say, in this wisdom as it appears here in the form of the ultimate waters of the divine, here in this verse.

15841.acip: BAm YIG DANG AOm GSUM MAS LHA DE RNAMS MTSON TE, BAm YIG ZHIG PA NA AA THUNG YA RA LA WA LNGAR 'GYUR LA, AA THUNG GIS RNAL 'BYOR MA, YAS L'A MA, RAS DUM SKYES MA, LAS GZUGS CAN MA, WAS MKHA' 'GRO MA STE BDE CHEN 'KHOR LO'I YUM LNGA,
15841.wylie: baM yig dang aoM gsum mas lha de rnams mtshon te, baM yig zhig pa na aa thung ya ra la wa lngar 'gyur la, aa thung gis rnal 'byor ma, yas lA ma, ras dum skyes ma, las gzugs can ma, was mkha' 'gro ma ste bde chen 'khor lo'i yum lnga
15841.english: The letter vam and the secret words of the triple om represent all of these Angels.  The vam can be broken down into its five component letters: the short a, the ya, ra, la, and va.  These represent the five Angels of the inner flower of great bliss: the short a stands for the Holy Angel, the ya for the Lady of La, the ra for the Lady of Pieces, the la for the Lady of Forms, and the va for the Lady of the Sky.

16156.acip: DE YANG SGRUB THABS THUN MONG MA YIN PA BDE CHEN NYE LAM LAS BYUNG BA LTAR BDUD RTZI MYANG BA'I RNAL 'BYOR NAS BKRA SHIS KYI BAR DANG , TSOGS KYI 'KHOR LO DANG BCAS PA BYA, GZHAN YANG BSNGO SMON SOGS NYAL KHA'I NYAMS LEN GYI RIM PA RNAMS LEGS BAR BYAS TE NYAL BA'I RNAL 'BYOR LA 'JUG,
16156.wylie: de yang sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa bde chen nye lam las byung ba ltar bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor nas bkra shis kyi bar dang , tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa bya, gzhan yang bsngo smon sogs nyal kha'i nyams len gyi rim pa rnams legs bar byas te nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug
16156.english: On the first night of your retreat start with the Practice of Taking Nectar and continue all the way up to the final verses of joyful fortune, using the unique ritual text for reaching the Angel entitled the Short Path to Great Bliss.  You should also perform the Offering of the Gathering and the final dedications, prayers, and so on.  Having gone carefully through all the practices that take you up to bedtime, start off on the Practice of Sleeping.

16217.acip: THUN ZHABS SU ZHAR BYUNG RDZOGS RIM GNYIS DANG , KHYAD PAR DU 'DI PA'I ZAB GNAD THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BSAM MI KHYAB KYI RNAL 'BYOR NYID NYAMS LEN GYI SNYING POR BYA DGOS PAS, KHRID YIG LAS 'BYUNG BA LTAR NAN TAN DU BSGOM PA GAL CHE'O,,
16217.wylie: thun zhabs su zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis dang , khyad par du 'di pa'i zab gnad thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor nyid nyams len gyi snying por bya dgos pas, khrid yig las 'byung ba ltar nan tan du bsgom pa gal che'o
16217.english: As you approach the end of your session, you must be sure to take yourself through two particular practices, as the very essence of your spiritual efforts.  These are first of all the two incidental practices of the stage of completion, and then more particularly that most profound and crucial point of all the practices of this Angel: the unique form of the Yoga of the Inconceivable.  Thus it is critical that you undertake these with intense effort, as laid forth in the book of instructions.

16553.acip: BCU PA BSAM GYIS MI KHYAB PA'I RNAL 'BYOR LA, BSAM MI KHYAB THUN MONG BA DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA GNYIS LAS, DANG PO NI,
16553.wylie: bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor la, bsam mi khyab thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las, dang po ni
16553.english: This brings us to the tenth of the Eleven Practices, which is the Practice of the Inconceivable.  Here there are two versions: the "common" and the "unique."  The first is explained as follows.

16658.acip: DER MA ZAD RANG RGYUD LA RDZOGS RIM GYI RTOGS PA SKYE BA SOGS KYI DGOS PA KHYAD PAR CAN DANG LDAN PA BLA MED THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I KHYAD CHOS YIN,
16658.wylie: der ma zad rang rgyud la rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa skye ba sogs kyi dgos pa khyad par can dang ldan pa bla med thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yin
