16658.english: Beyond all this, the Circle of Gathering is a unique instruction of the unsurpassed teachings which has a number of very special purposes, including a function of engendering in one's mental stream the realizations of the stage of completion.

16698.acip: NGED KYI SGRUB DKYIL DU, TING 'DZIN SNGAGS DANG ZHES SOGS NI GDANGS RGYUN YANG DBEN SA SNYAN BRGYUD THUN MONG MA YIN PA YOD PA DANG BCAS DE'I GNAD KYIS BLA MCHOD KYI TSOGS KYI CHO GA SOR BZHAG BYAS TE BKOD PA YIN,
16698.wylie: nged kyi sgrub dkyil du, ting 'dzin sngags dang zhes sogs ni gdangs rgyun yang dben sa snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa yod pa dang bcas de'i gnad kyis bla mchod kyi tshogs kyi cho ga sor bzhag byas te bkod pa yin
16698.english: Now the section--in my own version of the ritual for reaching Her secret world--which includes the refrain "Immaculate nectar blessed by our concentration, by our secret words" and so on comes with a unique melody that has been passed down through our oral tradition from Wensapa.  This is the special reason why I have added this part separately in my version of the Offering to Lamas.

16812.acip: MAN NGAG GZHAN MED PAR SKU GZUGS KYI RTEN YOD MED THAMS CAD LA KHYAD PAR MED PAR TSIGS BCAD GNYIS KA MNYAM DU 'GRO DGOS PA LTA BUR 'DON SROL DU BYED NA NI DAM PA'I PHYAG BZHES KHONG DU MA CHUD PA'I RTOG BZO'I RANG RTAGS SU GOR MA CHAG CING,
16812.wylie: man ngag gzhan med par sku gzugs kyi rten yod med thams cad la khyad par med par tshigs bcad gnyis ka mnyam du 'gro dgos pa lta bur 'don srol du byed na ni dam pa'i phyag bzhes khong du ma chud pa'i rtog bzo'i rang rtags su gor ma chag cing
16812.english: You see some people who, because they have not had the benefit of any oral instructions such as these, recite the two verses here as if they were supposed to go together, oblivious to the distinction of whether or not a sacred image of Her holy form involved.  But that custom is absolutely indisputably just an exhibition of making something up on your own because you have failed, miserably, to comprehend the proper tradition of Holy Ones of the past.

17083.acip: 'DI DAG GI SKABS THAMS CAD DU BSAM MI KHYAB THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I DMIGS PA GTZO BOR SKYONG,
17083.wylie: 'di dag gi skabs thams cad du bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa gtso bor skyong
17083.english: During all the steps we've described thus far, the main visualization you should be maintaining is that of the unique version of the Yoga of the Inconceivable.

17313.acip: CES PA STE, 'DI LA MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA'I SNGON 'GRO BZHI ZHES KYANG GSUNGS LA, DE YANG LAM LOG PA MU STEGS BYED LAS KHYAD PAR DU BYED PA SKYABS 'GRO'I 'KHRID, LAM DMAN PA NYAN RANG LAS KHYAD PAR DU BYED PA SEMS BSKYED KYI 'KHRID, SDIG SGRIB DAG PAR BYED PA RDOR SEMS SGOM BZLAS KYI 'KHRID, BYIN RLABS 'JUG PAR BYED PA BLA MA'I RNAL 'BYOR GYI 'KHRID RNAMS YIN PAS DANG PO GNYIS DANG BZHI PA TSAD MED KYI RNAL 'BYOR DON GCIG STE,
17313.wylie: ces pa ste, 'di la mthun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bzhi zhes kyang gsungs la, de yang lam log pa mu stegs byed las khyad par du byed pa skyabs 'gro'i 'khrid, lam dman pa nyan rang las khyad par du byed pa sems bskyed kyi 'khrid, sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi 'khrid, byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid rnams yin pas dang po gnyis dang bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor don gcig ste
17313.english: These are known as the four unique preliminaries.  Now the teachings on going for refuge are what distinguish the Buddhist path from mistaken paths of non-Buddhists.  The teachings on developing the Wish for enlightenment are what set this path apart from the two lower Buddhist paths of the listeners and self-realized ones.  The teachings on meditation and recitation of the Warrior of Diamond act to purify us of our negative actions and our obstacles.  And the teachings on the practice of the Lama allow us to receive the Lama's blessing.  Thus the first, second, and fourth of these are all considered the single deep practice of the limitless.

17323.acip: MU KHYUD KYI STENG MDO SNGAGS CI RIGS KYI DGE 'DUN CHOS SRUNG GIS BSKOR BA RNAMS RANG RANG GI MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GDAN BCAS SU GSAL BTAB LA,
17323.wylie: mu khyud kyi steng mdo sngags ci rigs kyi dge 'dun chos srung gis bskor ba rnams rang rang gi mthun mong ma yin pa'i gdan bcas su gsal btab la
17323.english: On the rim are communities of every different kind, open and secret, surrounded by dharma protectors.  Every one of these guests is seated on their own special seat.

17338.acip: DE YANG 'GA' ZHIG TU RTZA PA'I BLA MA DPA' BO RDO RJE CHOS SU BSGOM PA MTHUN MONG BA DANG, SANGS RGYAS RDO RJE CHOS RDOR DRIL 'DZIN PAR BSGOM PA MTHUN MONG MA YIN PAR BSHAD PA YOD KYANG, BDAG GI RJE BLA MA'I GZHUNG DU LCANG SKYA RIN PO CHE'I DGONGS PA LTAR DPA' PO RDO RJE CHOS SU BSGOM TSUL GSUNGS PA NI,
17338.wylie: de yang 'ga' zhig tu rtsa pa'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos su bsgom pa mthun mong ba dang, sangs rgyas rdo rje chos rdor dril 'dzin par bsgom pa mthun mong ma yin par bshad pa yod kyang, bdag gi rje bla ma'i gzhung du lcang skya rin po che'i dgongs pa ltar dpa' po rdo rje chos su bsgom tshul gsungs pa ni
17338.english: Now according to several sources, meditating on our Root Lama as Dharma of Diamond the Warrior is the shared method; while meditating on our Root Lama as Dharma of Diamond the Awakened One, who is holding a diamond and bell, is the unique method.  But in the text of my own Lord and Lama, He states that we should meditate on our Lama in the form of Dharma of Diamond the Warrior, as Changkya Rinpoche had intended.  Here is why we should do it this way.

17342.acip: YUM GYI MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA'I RTZA DBU MA CHUNG BA 'CHAD SKABS RTZA BA'I BLA MA RNAM PA DPA' BO RDO RJE CHOS GZHUNG DU GSAL BA LTAR BSGOM PA LA MTHUN MONG DANG MTHUN MONG MIN PA ZHES BSHAD PA LAS,
17342.wylie: yum gyi mthun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma chung ba 'chad skabs rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa dpa' bo rdo rje chos gzhung du gsal ba ltar bsgom pa la mthun mong dang mthun mong min pa zhes bshad pa las
17342.english: In the advices of those treatises on the lesser practice of the central channel, which is unique to the teachings of the Mother, meditation on our Root Lama is described in the as Their being in the form of Dharma of Diamond the Warrior, which is in keeping with the description in my Lama's text.

17345.acip: NGAG DBANG NYI ZLA BZANG PO'I RNAL 'BYOR BCU GCIG GI RNAM BSHAD LAS, 'DIR DPA' BO RDO RJE CHOS BSGOM PA NI MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA YIN LA, RDO RJE DANG DRIL BU 'DZIN BA NI BDE MCHOG DANG MTHUN MONG BA'I SKABS YIN NO, ,ZHES DANG,
17345.wylie: ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi rnam bshad las, 'dir dpa' bo rdo rje chos bsgom pa ni mthun mong ma yin pa yin la, rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin ba ni bde mchog dang mthun mong ba'i skabs yin no, ,zhes dang
17345.english: Our position concurs with Ngawang Nyinda Sangpo's text, Eleven Aspects of Deep Practice, where He states: "In this practice, meditating on Dharma of Diamond the Warrior is the unique method.  However, if he is holding a diamond and bell, it is that system which is shared with Highest Bliss."

17347.acip: KHA CIG 'DIR RDO RJE CHOS RDO RJE DANG DRIL BU 'DZIN PA DE BSGOM PAR BSHAD YOD KYANG, DE MTHUN MONG BA'I SKABS YIN PAS PHYAG LEN MTHUN MONG MA YIN BA BZHIN BSGOM GSUNGS, RNAM PA RDO RJE CHOS SU BSGOM PA NI GSUNG GI DNGOS GRUB STZOL BA'I RTEN 'BREL LO, ,ZHES GSUNGS,
17347.wylie: kha cig 'dir rdo rje chos rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa de bsgom par bshad yod kyang, de mthun mong ba'i skabs yin pas phyag len mthun mong ma yin ba bzhin bsgom gsungs, rnam pa rdo rje chos su bsgom pa ni gsung gi dngos grub stsol ba'i rten 'brel lo, ,zhes gsungs
17347.english: "Some have said of this Dharma of Diamond that we should see Him holding a diamond and bell; however, this is the custom in the treatises of the shared method, and it has been stated that we should meditate in the unique way.  But if we meditate on any form of Dharma of Diamond, it is a cause for receiving the attainments of enlightened speech."

17350.acip: LAR NAS GNYIS BRAL 'CHAD DUS ZHAL SHES GSUM, ZHES PA BLA MA BSKYED PA DANG, BLA MA BSTIM PA DANG, BSAM MI KHYAB MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA GSUM LA BSHAD 'DUG PA, GNYIS BRAL RDZOGS RIM GYI GDAMS PA 'CHAD DUS ZHAL SHES GSUM PO DE YANG 'CHAD PA'I PHYAG LEN YOD PA'I DON LAS,
17350.wylie: lar nas gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum, zhes pa bla ma bskyed pa dang, bla ma bstim pa dang, bsam mi khyab mthun mong ma yin pa gsum la bshad 'dug pa, gnyis bral rdzogs rim gyi gdams pa 'chad dus zhal shes gsum po de yang 'chad pa'i phyag len yod pa'i don las
17350.english: Coming back to that quote "When explaining non-duality, use the three private instructions," these three are said to be: creating the Lama, dissolving the Lama, and the unique inconceivable practice.  What this line means is that at the time when one is explaining, or giving advices about, non-duality--the stage of completion--it is a custom to explain these three private instructions as well.

17351.acip: DE SKABS ZHAL SHES GSUM GA NYAMS SU LEN PA'I DON MIN NAM SNYAM STE, DE LTAR BYAS NA RDZOGS RIM GYI SKABS SU NYAMS SU BLANG BYA NI BSAM MI KHYAB MTHUN MONG BAR GRAGS PA 'DI YIN LA, BSAM MI KHYAB MTHUN MONG MA YIN PAR GRAGS PA NI PHYI'I MKHA' SPYOD GTZO BOR SGRUB PA LANGGA LI YA'I SGRUB PA SOGS BSKYED RIM DANG 'GREL BA'I NYAMS SU BLANG BYA YIN PAS BLO RMONGS BDAG LTA BUR CUNG ZAD GO MI BDE BA MCHIS SO,,
17351.wylie: de skabs zhal shes gsum ga nyams su len pa'i don min nam snyam ste, de ltar byas na rdzogs rim gyi skabs su nyams su blang bya ni bsam mi khyab mthun mong bar grags pa 'di yin la, bsam mi khyab mthun mong ma yin par grags pa ni phyi'i mkha' spyod gtso bor sgrub pa langga li ya'i sgrub pa sogs bskyed rim dang 'grel ba'i nyams su blang bya yin pas blo rmongs bdag lta bur cung zad go mi bde ba mchis so
17351.english: However, it doesn't seem to me that all three of these instructions were meant to be put into practice at that time.  If that were the case, then instead of putting into practice that which is carried out during the stage of completion--the practice called the shared inconceivable--we would be doing the practice known as the unique inconceivable, which is connected with the stage of creation, and used mainly for reaching outer heaven, like those practices such as Langali.  And to a mind as dull as mine, this wouldn't make much sense. _______________

17472.acip: 'DI LA PHAG MO GZHAN GYI LUS DKYIL 'DIR BLANGS PA'I MTHUN MONG BA RTZA'I PHYI SNER BSGOM PA DANG, RJE BTZUN MA NYID KYIS N'A RO PAR STZAL BA'I SNYAN BRGYUD MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA RTZA'I NANG SNE SNYING GAR BSGOM PA GNYIS LAS 'DI NI PHYI MA YIN LA,
17472.wylie: 'di la phag mo gzhan gyi lus dkyil 'dir blangs pa'i mthun mong ba rtsa'i phyi sner bsgom pa dang, rje btsun ma nyid kyis nA ro par stsal ba'i snyan brgyud mthun mong ma yin pa rtsa'i nang sne snying gar bsgom pa gnyis las 'di ni phyi ma yin la
17472.english: Now the ordinary method for this practice--taking on here a secret world of the body according to other Sow lineages--is to meditate outside the openings of the channels.  But the unique method--the oral tradition which was granted to Naropa by the Holy Angel herself--is to meditate inside the openings of the channels, at the heart.  And this presentation follows the latter of the two.

17589.acip: GNYIS PA BSKYED RIM GYI 'BRAS BU 'GRUB PA'I THABS KHYAD PAR CAN LA SMON PA LA GNYIS, MYUR LAM 'PHO BA'I RNAL 'BYOR LA SOMON PA DANG, BSAM MI KHYAB MTHUN MONG MA YING PA LA SMON PA'O, ,DANG PO NI,
17589.wylie: gnyis pa bskyed rim gyi 'bras bu 'grub pa'i thabs khyad par can la smon pa la gnyis, myur lam 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor la somon pa dang, bsam mi khyab mthun mong ma ying pa la smon pa'o, ,dang po ni
17589.english: We are now on the second half of praying to achieve the goals of the stage of creation -- praying for special methods which achieve these goals.  There are two prayers for this: the prayer for the quick path -- the deep practice of transferring our consciousness; and the prayer for the unique practice of the inconceivable.  Here is the first:

17598.acip: YUM RKYANG LA BRTEN PA LA YANG MTHUN MONG DANG, MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA GNYIS YOD PA'I PHYI MA NI, NE GU CHOS DRUG GI 'PHO BA MA BSGOMS SANGS RGYAS ZHES PA'I NANG TSAN, ME TOG DKAR DMAR GNYIS DANG, N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD MA RANG GI 'PHO BA GSUM GYIS ZAB PA'I MAN NGAG GI SNYING PO THAMS CAD GCIG BSGRIL DU BYAS NAS NYAMS SU LEN PA STE,
17598.wylie: yum rkyang la brten pa la yang mthun mong dang, mthun mong ma yin pa gnyis yod pa'i phyi ma ni, ne gu chos drug gi 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas zhes pa'i nang tshan, me tog dkar dmar gnyis dang, nA ro mkha' spyod ma rang gi 'pho ba gsum gyis zab pa'i man ngag gi snying po thams cad gcig bsgril du byas nas nyams su len pa ste
17598.english: For that practice where we use a female Angel alone, there are again two different types: the shared and the unique.  And the latter one is three different practices rolled into one--the very essence of all the profound instructions: the practice of transferral found in the six yogas of Niguma, which is part of the section called "Buddhahood without meditation"; the sending practice of the two flowers, red and white; and our own practice of sending according to the heaven of Naropa.

17641.acip: 'DIR ZAB LAM N'A RO'I CHOS DRUG CES KUN TU GRAGS PA'I GDAMS NGAG 'CHAD PA LA GNYIS TE, GANG LA BRTEN NAS LAM 'DI SGOM PA'I SNGON 'GRO DANG, DE LA BRTEN NAS LAM 'DI JI LTAR BSGOM PA'O, ,DANG PO LA GNYIS, SNGON 'GRO DANG PO THEG CHEN THUN MONG BA'I LAM DANG, THUN MONG MA YIN PA BLA MED KYI THEG PA'I SNGON 'GRO'O,,
17641.wylie: 'dir zab lam nA ro'i chos drug ces kun tu grags pa'i gdams ngag 'chad pa la gnyis te, gang la brten nas lam 'di sgom pa'i sngon 'gro dang, de la brten nas lam 'di ji ltar bsgom pa'o, ,dang po la gnyis, sngon 'gro dang po theg chen thun mong ba'i lam dang, thun mong ma yin pa bla med kyi theg pa'i sngon 'gro'o
17641.english: Our presentation of the advices widely known as the "Profound Path of the Six Practices of Naropa" will proceed in two steps: a discussion of the preliminaries that lead one into the practice of this path, and the actual path that one practices, led there through the preliminaries. The first of these has two divisions of its own: the initial preliminaries--that is, the path which is shared throughout the greater way; and the unique preliminaries of the unsurpassed way.

17684.acip: GNYIS PA THUN MONG MA YIN PA BLA MED KYI THEG PA'I SNGON 'GRO LA GNYIS, SPYI'I SNGON 'GRO DANG, KHYAD PAR GYI SNGON 'GRO'O, ,DANG PO LA GNYIS, DBANG RDZOGS PAR THOB DGOS PAR BSTAN PA DANG, DAM TSIG RNAMS BSRUNG DGOS PAR BSTAN PA'O,,
17684.wylie: gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa bla med kyi theg pa'i sngon 'gro la gnyis, spyi'i sngon 'gro dang, khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'o, ,dang po la gnyis, dbang rdzogs par thob dgos par bstan pa dang, dam tshig rnams bsrung dgos par bstan pa'o
17684.english: Second now are the unique preliminaries of the unsurpassed way.  Here there are two divisions: the general preliminaries and the special ones.  The first of these comes in two parts of its own, which are a demonstration that one must be granted a complete initiation, and a demonstration that one must honor one's commitments.

17752.acip: DE NAS GUS PA CHEN POS THUN MONG DANG, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAM RNAMS MYUR DU RGYUD LA SKYE BA DANG, DE DAG GI 'GAL RKYEN ZHI ZHING MTHUN RKYEN YID BZHIN DU 'GRUB PA'I GSOL BA BTAB PAS, DGYES TE BLA MA'I GNAS GSUM GYI YI GE LAS 'OD ZER DKAR DMAR MTHING GSUM 'PHROS PA,
17752.wylie: de nas gus pa chen pos thun mong dang, thun mong ma yin pa'i lam rnams myur du rgyud la skye ba dang, de dag gi 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i gsol ba btab pas, dgyes te bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pa
17752.english: With deep feelings of devotion then beg your Lama to assist you in reaching within you both the shared and the unique paths, with all possible speed.  Ask Them to help put an end to anything that might prevent you from reaching these paths, and to help you attain everything that might help you do so, just as your heart desires.  Imagine then that your Lama is filled with pleasure over your request, and that light rays of three colors--white, red, and dark blue--fly out from the sacred syllables at the three places on Her or His body.

17829.acip: 'KHOR LO RNAMS KYI NANG NAS LUGS 'DI LA THOG MAR GNAD DU BSNUN SA NI SPRUL PA'I 'KHOR LO YIN NO, ,DE DAG GIS NI RTZA 'KHOR SO SOR DMIGS PA GTAD NAS SKYONG BA LA, RANG RANG GI LAG RJES THUN MONG MA YIN PA JI LTAR 'ONG GZHAN YANG SHES DGOS PA RTOGS PAR BYA'O,,
17829.wylie: 'khor lo rnams kyi nang nas lugs 'di la thog mar gnad du bsnun sa ni sprul pa'i 'khor lo yin no, ,de dag gis ni rtsa 'khor so sor dmigs pa gtad nas skyong ba la, rang rang gi lag rjes thun mong ma yin pa ji ltar 'ong gzhan yang shes dgos pa rtogs par bya'o
17829.english: Of all the chakras in the body, the one we work with first in this system is the chakra of emanation.  All of these practices are accomplished by turning ones focus to each of the individual major chakras; you should realize that this kind of focus leaves its own unique imprint at each center--this is something you will learn through experience.

18022.acip: SNYING GA'I PHYOGS KYI RTZA 'DAB BZHI LAS 'BYUNG BA BZHI'I RLUNG RGYU BAS 'BYUNG BA'I RTZA DANG , MTSAMS KYI RTZA BZHI LAS GZUGS DRI RO REG BYA BZHI 'BAB PAS MCHOD PA'I RTZA ZHES BSHAD CING , BSHANG GCI KHU KHRAG BAD KAN TE BDUD RTZI LNGA 'BAB PAR YANG BSHAD DO,,
18022.wylie: snying ga'i phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhi las 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu bas 'byung ba'i rtsa dang , mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi las gzugs dri ro reg bya bzhi 'bab pas mchod pa'i rtsa zhes bshad cing , bshang gci khu khrag bad kan te bdud rtsi lnga 'bab par yang bshad do
18022.english: Now because the winds of the four elements flow through the four channel petals of the heart that correspond to the cardinal directions, these channels themselves are also spoken of as the "channels of the elements."  And because the four of visible, smellable, tastable, and tangible objects flow through the four channels of the ordinal directions, these are also known as the "channels of offering."  It is also said that feces, urine, semen, blood, and phlegm--the five nectars--flow through these channels.

18149.acip: DANG PO LA GNYIS, YAB BKA' DANG MTHUN MONG GI RTZA DBU MA CHE BA'I LAM RGYUD LA SKYE BAR SMON PA DANG, YUM BKA'I MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA RTZA DBU MA CHUNG BA'I LAM RGYUD LA SKYE BAR SMON PA'O,,
18149.wylie: dang po la gnyis, yab bka' dang mthun mong gi rtsa dbu ma che ba'i lam rgyud la skye bar smon pa dang, yum bka'i mthun mong ma yin pa rtsa dbu ma chung ba'i lam rgyud la skye bar smon pa'o
18149.english: Now this first part has two versions: praying to develop in our minds the path of the "greater" practice of the central channel, which is shared with the Father teachings; and praying to develop in our minds the path of the "lesser" practice of the central channel, which is unique to the Mother teachings.

18160.acip: DANG PO LA YAB YUM MTHUN MONG DANG, MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA GNYIS, DANG PO LA YANG SNGON DU RLUNG SBYANG BA, RANG LHAG PAR GNAS PA'I RIM PA'AM BDAG BYIN GYIS BRLAB PA'I RIM PA, RTZA DBU MA KHA DBYE BA'I RNAL 'BYOR TE GSUM YOD KYANG, SMON LAM 'DIR SA BCAD DANG PO GNYIS LTE BA'I PADMOR ZHES SOGS TSIGS BCAD GCIG GI KHONGS SU BSDUS TE GSUNGS LA,
18160.wylie: dang po la yab yum mthun mong dang, mthun mong ma yin pa gnyis, dang po la yang sngon du rlung sbyang ba, rang lhag par gnas pa'i rim pa'am bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa, rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i rnal 'byor te gsum yod kyang, smon lam 'dir sa bcad dang po gnyis lte ba'i padmor zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi khongs su bsdus te gsungs la
18160.english: This first method has two versions: the one which is shared by both the Father and the Mother, and the one which is unique.  For the shared version, there is the preliminary practice of exercising the winds, the practice of consecrating yourself (also called the stage of blessing yourself), and the deep practice of opening the central channel.  So there are three practices in the shared version, but in the structure of this prayer we find the first two of them contained within that one verse which includes the line At the lotus of the navel... The Droplets of Five Winds

18230.acip: 'DI LA SNGON 'GRO DANG, DNGOS GZHI GNYIS, DANG PO LA THUN MONG GI SNGON 'GRO DANG, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I SNGON 'GRO GNYIS LAS,
18230.wylie: 'di la sngon 'gro dang, dngos gzhi gnyis, dang po la thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang, thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis las
18230.english: We may proceed then in two steps--the preliminaries and the main part of the practice.  The preliminaries themselves are also two: those which are shared, and those which are unique.

18232.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I SNGON 'GRO LA RTZA LAM SBYANG BA DANG, RLUNG SBYANG BA GNYIS, DE GNYIS DANG, GNYIS PA DNGOS GZHI BDAG BYIN RLABS BCAS STON PA NI, LTE BA'I PADMOR RLUNG LNGA'I TI LA KA, ZHES SOGS TE
18232.wylie: thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la rtsa lam sbyang ba dang, rlung sbyang ba gnyis, de gnyis dang, gnyis pa dngos gzhi bdag byin rlabs bcas ston pa ni, lte ba'i padmor rlung lnga'i ti la ka, zhes sogs te
18232.english: The unique preliminaries include two parts: cleaning the paths of the channels, and cleaning the winds.  These two, together with the second step here--the main stage of the practice, which is blessing oneself--are indicated in the lines that include: . . .the droplets of five winds At the lotus of the navel.

18375.acip: DANG PO NI, LUGS 'DI LA GTUM MO SGOM NAS RLUNG DBU MAR 'DZUD PA DGOS ZHES PA GSAL BAR SNANG YANG, SROG DH'U T'IR TSUD PA LA BRTEN NAS SGYU LUS DANG, 'OD GSAL GNYIS SGOM TSUL SHIN TU MI GSAL ZHING, DE RNAMS SHIN TU RTOGS DKA' BAR BYUNG SNANG MOD KYANG, 'DIR MAN NGAG LA GO BA THUN MONG MA YIN PA CHAGS PA'I PHYIR DU CUNG ZAD CIG BRJOD PAR BYA'O,,
18375.wylie: dang po ni, lugs 'di la gtum mo sgom nas rlung dbu mar 'dzud pa dgos zhes pa gsal bar snang yang, srog dhU tIr tshud pa la brten nas sgyu lus dang, 'od gsal gnyis sgom tshul shin tu mi gsal zhing, de rnams shin tu rtogs dka' bar byung snang mod kyang, 'dir man ngag la go ba thun mong ma yin pa chags pa'i phyir du cung zad cig brjod par bya'o
18375.english: Here is the first.  Now the teachings on this practice clearly state that one must get the winds to enter the central channel by utilizing the practice of inner fire.  They are extremely unclear though on how you're supposed to practice reaching the pair of the body of illusion and the clear light by utilizing your successful attempt to get the life winds to move into this channel of dance.  It is moreover quite apparent that we are talking about stages that are very difficult to actually have a personal experience of.  Nonetheless I am going to say a bit about these points here, so that you can eventually come to a very special understanding of the advices of this tradition.

18385.acip: 'DI'I SGYU LUS DNGOS NI RNAL 'BYOR BLA MED KYI RDZOGS RIM THUN MONG MA YIN PA YIN LA, SNGAR BSHAD PA'I SGYU LUS DANG POR BZHAG PA LA NI, SPYI DON GYI SGYU MA'I MTSAN NYID TSANG BA'ANG MI SNANG LA, GNYIS PAR 'DOD PA NI RGYUD SDE 'OG MA GSUM LAS KYANG DU MA ZHIG 'BYUNG BA'I PHYIR RO,,
18385.wylie: 'di'i sgyu lus dngos ni rnal 'byor bla med kyi rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa yin la, sngar bshad pa'i sgyu lus dang por bzhag pa la ni, spyi don gyi sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'ang mi snang la, gnyis par 'dod pa ni rgyud sde 'og ma gsum las kyang du ma zhig 'byung ba'i phyir ro
18385.english: The real body of illusion being talked about here is the one which is unique to the completion level of the way of unsurpassed practice.  The first thing described above as being the body of illusion doesn't even appear to fit the most general meaning of "illusion," whereas the belief that the body of illusion is the second thing mentioned can be found even in many works of the lower three groups of secret teachings.

18448.acip: DE LA SNGAGS KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I RMI LAM 'DZIN LUGS GTZO BO NI SNGA MA YIN LA, PHYI MA NI THUN MONG BA PHAL PA'O,,
18448.wylie: de la sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rmi lam 'dzin lugs gtso bo ni snga ma yin la, phyi ma ni thun mong ba phal pa'o
18448.english: Now the primary and unique method, in the secret way, of achieving recognition during your dreams is the first of the above; the latter is the common one, the ordinary one.

18608.acip: DE BZHIN DU 'CHI RIM RNAMS 'BYUNG 'GYUR LA'ANG DE BZHIN DU SBYANGS NA, 'CHI RIM GYI STONG PA'I SKABS SU TING NGE 'DZIN RGYUN RING BA TZAM BYUNG YANG, TSE 'DIR RLUNG STOBS KYIS 'CHI BA'I 'OD GSAL ZIN PA MIN PAS, RNAL 'BYOR BLA MED KYI LAM THUN MONG MA YIN PAR BZHAG PAR DKA'O,,
18608.wylie: de bzhin du 'chi rim rnams 'byung 'gyur la'ang de bzhin du sbyangs na, 'chi rim gyi stong pa'i skabs su ting nge 'dzin rgyun ring ba tsam byung yang, tshe 'dir rlung stobs kyis 'chi ba'i 'od gsal zin pa min pas, rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam thun mong ma yin par bzhag par dka'o
18608.english: Similarly, one might practice going through the various stages of death in the same way, even long before they actually occurred.  It might be possible then that one could, during the emptiness parts of the stages of the death process, maintain a state of meditative concentration for an extended period of time.  This would not though constitute the act of recognizing the clear light of death through the work one had done with ones winds during the present life; and so we would be hard pressed to say that this could be called a unique path of the secret teachings of unsurpassed, deep practice.

18619.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA NI YUL GYI 'OD GSAL DE KHO NA NYID LA KHYAD PAR MED KYANG, YUL CAN LHAN SKYES KYI BDE BA CHEN POS DE RTOGS PA NI, RNAL 'BYOR BLA MED NYID KYI KHYAD CHOS YIN PAS, THUN MONG MA YIN PA ZHES BYA'O, ,'DI'I YANG GTZO BO NI RLUNG DBU MAR ZHUGS GNAS THIM GSUM BYAS PA LAS BYUNG BA'I LHAN SKYES KYI RDZOGS RIM PA'I BDE BA DGOS SO,,
18619.wylie: thun mong ma yin pa ni yul gyi 'od gsal de kho na nyid la khyad par med kyang, yul can lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen pos de rtogs pa ni, rnal 'byor bla med nyid kyi khyad chos yin pas, thun mong ma yin pa zhes bya'o, ,'di'i yang gtso bo ni rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i lhan skyes kyi rdzogs rim pa'i bde ba dgos so
18619.english: What we call the "unique" clear light--in the form of the clear light of the object, the suchness--differs in no way from the other.  In the form of the subject, however--the state of mind which realizes this object and is also simultaneous, great bliss--it is something which is unique to the class of unsurpassed practice; and therefore the name "unique." And for this the main thing that's needed is the simultaneous bliss of the state of completion: the bliss that comes from getting the winds to enter, stay, and dissolve into the central channel.

18691.acip: DANG PO NI, RNAM SHES GONG DU 'PHO BA'I GDAMS NGAG 'DI NI, RNAL 'BYOR BLA MED KYI RGYUD KYI KHYAD CHOS CHEN PO ZHIG YIN LA, 'DI YANG BDE DGYES GNYIS KA'I THUN MONG GI BSHAD RGYUD SAM BHU tA DANG, BDE MCHOG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BSHAD RGYUD RDO RJE MKHA' 'GRO DANG, BDE MCHOG SDOM 'BYUNG GNYIS DANG, RDO RJE GDAN BZHI'I RTZA RGYUD DANG, RJE BTZUN 'JAM DPAL GYI ZHAL GYI LUNG LA SOGS PA NAS GSUNGS SO,,
18691.wylie: dang po ni, rnam shes gong du 'pho ba'i gdams ngag 'di ni, rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud kyi khyad chos chen po zhig yin la, 'di yang bde dgyes gnyis ka'i thun mong gi bshad rgyud sam bhu Ta dang, bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang, bde mchog sdom 'byung gnyis dang, rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rtsa rgyud dang, rje btsun 'jam dpal gyi zhal gyi lung la sogs pa nas gsungs so
18691.english: Here then is the first of the two.  The advices for transferring our consciousness to a higher level are a great and unique feature of the secret teachings of the unsurpassed deep practice.  They are described in works such as Samputa, which is an explanatory tantra common to the secret systems of Highest Bliss and Lo Diamond; the Angel Diamond of the Sky, an explanatory tantra which is unique to Highest Bliss, and the Source of Vows, which also belongs to the teachings of Highest Bliss; the root tantra of the Four Seats of Diamond; and the Word of the Holy Gentle Voice.

18721.acip: SPYIR BDE 'GRO'I GNAS TZAM DU 'PHO BA'I GDAMS NGAG LA YANG, KHYAD PAR CHE MOD KYANG, RGYUD SDE'I DGONGS PA NI SNGAGS SPYOD PA'I RIG 'DZIN GYI RTEN MCHOG TU 'PHO BAR BYED PA YIN LA, DE LA THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I TING NGE 'DZIN KYI STOBS KYIS SGO GZHAN BRGYAD NAS RNAM SHES 'PHO BA 'GOG NUS SHING, GSER GYI SGO NAS 'PHO NUS PA CIG DGOS SO,,
18721.wylie: spyir bde 'gro'i gnas tsam du 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la yang, khyad par che mod kyang, rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ni sngags spyod pa'i rig 'dzin gyi rten mchog tu 'pho bar byed pa yin la, de la thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyi stobs kyis sgo gzhan brgyad nas rnam shes 'pho ba 'gog nus shing, gser gyi sgo nas 'pho nus pa cig dgos so
18721.english: Now generally speaking--even with the instructions for sending the mind on to no more than a rebirth in one of the higher realms--this next is especially important.  But the true intent of the teachings of the secret way is that we do our practice of sending the mind on in order to reach that supreme form of body and mind with which we become a holder of knowledge who practices the path of the secret word.  And for this we need to be someone who is capable, through the sheer force of our extraordinary level of meditative concentration, of stopping the consciousness from moving on through any of the other eight doors--who is capable of sending it on through the golden door.

18779.acip: GTUM MO LA SOGS PA'I GNAD RNAMS LEGS PAR THON PA DANG, CUNG ZAD RNAM PAR DBYE DGOS PA THUN MONG BA DANG, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I TSUL RNAMS SO SOR PHYE BA CIG GYIS ZHES BSKUL BA'I DON DU DANG,
18779.wylie: gtum mo la sogs pa'i gnad rnams legs par thon pa dang, cung zad rnam par dbye dgos pa thun mong ba dang, thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul rnams so sor phye ba cig gyis zhes bskul ba'i don du dang
18779.english: It was written for the sake of those who had asked me to compose a book that brought out, clearly, all the critical points of practices such as that of the inner fire; and which brought out as well the differences between the normal ways of doing these practices, and the special ways--something that needed to be clarified.

18916.acip: DE NAS RIM PAR BRGYUD DE BDAG GI DRIN CAN RTZA BA'I BLA MA GRUB PA'I DBANG PHYUG CHEN PO GANG DE'I BAR DU BYON PA LAS KHO BO CAG GIS LEGS PAR MNOS PA'I NYE RGYUD KHYAD PAR CAN DPAL LDAN DMAG ZOR LHA MO LA LAS BZHI LHA MOS BSKOR BA DANG GSANG SGRUB DANG BCAS PA'I SROG DBANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA GSANG BA LAS KYANG CHES GSANG BA 'DI NYID 'BUL BAR BYED PA LA,
18916.wylie: de nas rim par brgyud de bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gang de'i bar du byon pa las kho bo cag gis legs par mnos pa'i nye rgyud khyad par can dpal ldan dmag zor lha mo la las bzhi lha mos bskor ba dang gsang sgrub dang bcas pa'i srog dbang thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba 'di nyid 'bul bar byed pa la
18916.english: From Him the teaching came down From generation to generation, Until it reached our own Root Lama, The great Lord of Sages, Who granted it to us. And now we impart this same to you, Secret beyond all secrets, A private and wondrous lineage, The unique empowerment of life Belonging to the glorious one, The Queen of the End of War, In the company of the Goddesses Of the Four Modes, along with The Lady of Secret Practice. The Mandala of Recompense

18940.acip: (,THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GSOL GDAB NI,) HO: ,DKYIL 'KHOR GTZO MCHOG KHRAG 'THUNG DPAL, ,DPA' BO CHEN PO BDAG LA DGONGS, ,SANGS RGYAS BSTAN PA BSRUNG BA DANG, ,ZHI RGYAS DBANG DRAG LAS GRUB PHYIR, ,SRID GSUM DBANG BSGYUR RE MA TI, ,MA MO DRAG MO MTHU RTZAL CAN, ,'JAM RGYAS DBANG GI LHAG PA'I LHA, ,DAM TSIG CAN GYI SROG DBANG STZOL, (,ZHES LAN GSUM GYIS GSOL BA 'DAB,)
18940.wylie: (,thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab ni,) ho: ,dkyil 'khor gtso mchog khrag 'thung dpal, ,dpa' bo chen po bdag la dgongs, ,sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang, ,zhi rgyas dbang drag las grub phyir, ,srid gsum dbang bsgyur re ma ti, ,ma mo drag mo mthu rtsal can, ,'jam rgyas dbang gi lhag pa'i lha, ,dam tshig can gyi srog dbang stsol, (,zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'dab,)
18940.english: We come now to the unique supplication: Ho! Hear my plea, Lord of the Mandala, Eminent One, shining Drinker of the Blood, Warrior most mighty. I seek to protect the teachings, And to attain the skills Of peace, prosperity, power, and ferocity. And so I beg that You grant me The empowerment of life Into those who possess the pledges-- Into the secret teachings of Remati, Empress of All Three Realms, The Witch, the Angry One, Mistress of Mystic Powers; And into those of the Goddesses Beyond all other goddesses: Those gentle, generous, powerful.

19428.acip: (THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GSOL GDAB NI,) ,'DOD KHAMS DBANG PHYUG 'CHI MED LHA, ,RAB DKAR ZHI BA'I NYAMS LDAN PA'I, ,SKU GSUNG THUGS KYI TSE YI DBANG, ,DUS 'DIR BDAG LA STZAL DU GSOL, (LAN GSUM RJES ZLOS BYED DU BCUG ,)
19428.wylie: (thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab ni,) ,'dod khams dbang phyug 'chi med lha, ,rab dkar zhi ba'i nyams ldan pa'i, ,sku gsung thugs kyi tshe yi dbang, ,dus 'dir bdag la stsal du gsol, (lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug ,)
19428.english: This brings us to the unique supplication.  Have the disciple repeat it after you, three times: I beg that here now You grant me The empowerment of life Into the holy body, And words, and thoughts, Of the Empress of the Desire Realm, Goddess of Deathlessness, She with that look Of snow-white peace.

19518.acip: GNYIS PA YUM BKA'I MTHUN MONG MA YIN PA RTZA DBU MA CHUNG BA'I LAM RGYUD LA SKYE BAR SMON PA LA GNYIS, CHOS NYID BRGYUD NAS STON PA'I LAM LA SMON PA DANG , CHOS NYID DNGOS SU STON PA'I LAM LA SMON PA'O,,
19518.wylie: gnyis pa yum bka'i mthun mong ma yin pa rtsa dbu ma chung ba'i lam rgyud la skye bar smon pa la gnyis, chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa'i lam la smon pa dang , chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i lam la smon pa'o
19518.english: We come now to the second version of the path of the completion stage.  This is the version unique to the teaching of the Mother--praying to develop in our minds the path of the "lesser" central channel. Within this are two methods: the prayer for the practice where the true nature of a thing is taught through a medium, and the prayer for the practice where the true nature of a thing is taught directly.

19536.acip: LUGS 'DI'I DBU MA'I RTZA KHA DBYE BA'I SKOR RNAMS RDZOGS RIM GZHAN LTAR BYAS NA CUNG MI BDE BA LTA BU YOD KYANG 'DI'I THUN MONG MA YIN PA YIN,
19536.wylie: lugs 'di'i dbu ma'i rtsa kha dbye ba'i skor rnams rdzogs rim gzhan ltar byas na cung mi bde ba lta bu yod kyang 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa yin
19536.english: If thus we perform the practices in this system for opening the central channel following other systems for the stage of completion, it might seem a little odd; but this is in fact a unique and wonderful feature of this teaching.

19693.acip: DE BZHIN DU 'CHI RIM RNAMS 'BYUNG 'GYUR LA'ANG DE BZHIN DU SBYANGS NA, 'CHI RIM GYI STONG PA'I SKABS SU TING NGE 'DZIN RGYUN RING BA TZAM BYUNG YANG, TSE 'DIR RLUNG STOBS KYIS 'CHI BA'I 'OD GSAL ZIN PA MIN PAS, RNAL 'BYOR BLA MED KYI LAM THUN MONG MA YIN PAR BZHAG PAR DKA'O,,
19693.wylie: de bzhin du 'chi rim rnams 'byung 'gyur la'ang de bzhin du sbyangs na, 'chi rim gyi stong pa'i skabs su ting nge 'dzin rgyun ring ba tsam byung yang, tshe 'dir rlung stobs kyis 'chi ba'i 'od gsal zin pa min pas, rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam thun mong ma yin par bzhag par dka'o
19693.english: Similarly, one might practice going through the various stages of death in the same way, even long before they actually occurred.  It might be possible then that one could, during the emptiness parts of the stages of the death process, maintain a state of meditative concentration for an extended period of time.  This would not though constitute the act of recognizing the clear light of death through the work one had done with ones winds during the present life; and so we would be hard pressed to say that this could be called a unique path of the secret teachings of unsurpassed, deep practice.

19704.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA NI YUL GYI 'OD GSAL DE KHO NA NYID LA KHYAD PAR MED KYANG, YUL CAN LHAN SKYES KYI BDE BA CHEN POS DE RTOGS PA NI, RNAL 'BYOR BLA MED NYID KYI KHYAD CHOS YIN PAS, THUN MONG MA YIN PA ZHES BYA'O, ,'DI'I YANG GTZO BO NI RLUNG DBU MAR ZHUGS GNAS THIM GSUM BYAS PA LAS BYUNG BA'I LHAN SKYES KYI RDZOGS RIM PA'I BDE BA DGOS SO,,
19704.wylie: thun mong ma yin pa ni yul gyi 'od gsal de kho na nyid la khyad par med kyang, yul can lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen pos de rtogs pa ni, rnal 'byor bla med nyid kyi khyad chos yin pas, thun mong ma yin pa zhes bya'o, ,'di'i yang gtso bo ni rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i lhan skyes kyi rdzogs rim pa'i bde ba dgos so
19704.english: What we call the "unique" clear light--in the form of the clear light of the object, the suchness--differs in no way from the other.  In the form of the subject, however--the state of mind which realizes this object and is also simultaneous, great bliss--it is something which is unique to the class of unsurpassed practice; and therefore the name "unique." And for this the main thing that's needed is the simultaneous bliss of the state of completion: the bliss that comes from getting the winds to enter, stay, and dissolve into the central channel.

19772.acip: DANG PO NI, RNAM SHES GONG DU 'PHO BA'I GDAMS NGAG 'DI NI, RNAL 'BYOR BLA MED KYI RGYUD KYI KHYAD CHOS CHEN PO ZHIG YIN LA, 'DI YANG BDE DGYES GNYIS KA'I THUN MONG GI BSHAD RGYUD SAM BHU tA DANG, BDE MCHOG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BSHAD RGYUD RDO RJE MKHA' 'GRO DANG, BDE MCHOG SDOM 'BYUNG GNYIS DANG, RDO RJE GDAN BZHI'I RTZA RGYUD DANG, RJE BTZUN 'JAM DPAL GYI ZHAL GYI LUNG LA SOGS PA NAS GSUNGS SO,,
19772.wylie: dang po ni, rnam shes gong du 'pho ba'i gdams ngag 'di ni, rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud kyi khyad chos chen po zhig yin la, 'di yang bde dgyes gnyis ka'i thun mong gi bshad rgyud sam bhu Ta dang, bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang, bde mchog sdom 'byung gnyis dang, rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rtsa rgyud dang, rje btsun 'jam dpal gyi zhal gyi lung la sogs pa nas gsungs so
19772.english: Here then is the first of the two.  The advices for transferring our consciousness to a higher level are a great and unique feature of the secret teachings of the unsurpassed deep practice.  They are described in works such as Samputa, which is an explanatory tantra common to the secret systems of Highest Bliss and Lo Diamond; the Angel Diamond of the Sky, an explanatory tantra which is unique to Highest Bliss, and the Source of Vows, which also belongs to the teachings of Highest Bliss; the root tantra of the Four Seats of Diamond; and the Word of the Holy Gentle Voice.

19802.acip: SPYIR BDE 'GRO'I GNAS TZAM DU 'PHO BA'I GDAMS NGAG LA YANG, KHYAD PAR CHE MOD KYANG, RGYUD SDE'I DGONGS PA NI SNGAGS SPYOD PA'I RIG 'DZIN GYI RTEN MCHOG TU 'PHO BAR BYED PA YIN LA, DE LA THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I TING NGE 'DZIN KYI STOBS KYIS SGO GZHAN BRGYAD NAS RNAM SHES 'PHO BA 'GOG NUS SHING, GSER GYI SGO NAS 'PHO NUS PA CIG DGOS SO,,
19802.wylie: spyir bde 'gro'i gnas tsam du 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la yang, khyad par che mod kyang, rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ni sngags spyod pa'i rig 'dzin gyi rten mchog tu 'pho bar byed pa yin la, de la thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyi stobs kyis sgo gzhan brgyad nas rnam shes 'pho ba 'gog nus shing, gser gyi sgo nas 'pho nus pa cig dgos so
19802.english: Now generally speaking--even with the instructions for sending the mind on to no more than a rebirth in one of the higher realms--this next is especially important.  But the true intent of the teachings of the secret way is that we do our practice of sending the mind on in order to reach that supreme form of body and mind with which we become a holder of knowledge who practices the path of the secret word.  And for this we need to be someone who is capable, through the sheer force of our extraordinary level of meditative concentration, of stopping the consciousness from moving on through any of the other eight doors--who is capable of sending it on through the golden door.

19860.acip: GTUM MO LA SOGS PA'I GNAD RNAMS LEGS PAR THON PA DANG, CUNG ZAD RNAM PAR DBYE DGOS PA THUN MONG BA DANG, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I TSUL RNAMS SO SOR PHYE BA CIG GYIS ZHES BSKUL BA'I DON DU DANG,
19860.wylie: gtum mo la sogs pa'i gnad rnams legs par thon pa dang, cung zad rnam par dbye dgos pa thun mong ba dang, thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul rnams so sor phye ba cig gyis zhes bskul ba'i don du dang
19860.english: It was written for the sake of those who had asked me to compose a book that brought out, clearly, all the critical points of practices such as that of the inner fire; and which brought out as well the differences between the normal ways of doing these practices, and the special ways--something that needed to be clarified.

19978.acip: BDE STONG SBYOR 'DOD NAS BYED PA GTAN MIN PA DANG DBANG DANG DAM TSIG THUN MONG MA YIN PAS SNOD RUNG DU BSGRUB PA DANG, YUL RTEN GNYIS SNGAGS DANG LHA'I RNAL 'BYOR LA SOGS PAS SBYANGS PA'I THABS MKHAS KYANG MED PAS, LAM DER PHYAG RGYA'I SBYOR BAS SA GSUM BZA' BAR BYA ZHES MI GSUNG NGO,,
19978.wylie: bde stong sbyor 'dod nas byed pa gtan min pa dang dbang dang dam tshig thun mong ma yin pas snod rung du bsgrub pa dang, yul rten gnyis sngags dang lha'i rnal 'byor la sogs pas sbyangs pa'i thabs mkhas kyang med pas, lam der phyag rgya'i sbyor bas sa gsum bza' bar bya zhes mi gsung ngo
19978.english: That though is not in any way done out of a desire to combine bliss and emptiness; and in that path, there is no custom of making the disciple a proper vessel by granting them empowerment, and unique commitments.  Nor in that path do there exist unexpected spiritual means such as where the person seeking union and the person they seek to perform union with engage in practices of mantra, and in turning themselves into Angels.  We could not say then that in the open path of the greater way the three realms had been "devoured" through union with a partner.

20159.acip: DE MI 'THOB PA TZAM DU ZAD DAM SNYAM NA, BLA NA MED PA'I SNGAGS KYI SGRUB PA POS KHAMS PHYIR 'DZAG PA'I BDE BA LA CHAGS PA LAS NI BDE CHEN MI 'THOB PA TZAM DU MA ZAD SDIG PAR 'GYUR TE GANG GI PHYIR NA, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I TSAD MED PA BZHI ZAD PAR BYED PA'I PHYIR RO,,
20159.wylie: de mi 'thob pa tsam du zad dam snyam na, bla na med pa'i sngags kyi sgrub pa pos khams phyir 'dzag pa'i bde ba la chags pa las ni bde chen mi 'thob pa tsam du ma zad sdig par 'gyur te gang gi phyir na, thun mong ma yin pa'i tshad med pa bzhi zad par byed pa'i phyir ro
20159.english: One may ask, "Is that all? Is it only that they fail to reach this ecstasy?"  No--it's not just that a practitioner of the unsurpassed form of the way of the secret word who is attracted to the pleasure of having their element pour out of the body only loses an opportunity to reach great bliss.  Because they also collect a serious bad karma.  Why is this?  Because there is a very special form of the Four Infinite Thoughts; and by engaging in the practice this way, they kill these four.

20300.acip: DE LA SOGS PA SO SOR LUNG BSTAN PA SHIN TU MANG, DE LTAR THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I RTOGS PA THAMS CAD THUGS RGYUD LA 'KHRUNGS,
20300.wylie: de la sogs pa so sor lung bstan pa shin tu mang, de ltar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa thams cad thugs rgyud la 'khrungs
20300.english: There were thus a great many events foretelling Je Tsongkapa's practice with His partner; and in this way He was able to give birth, within His heart, to all of the different types of realizations--both the common and the unique. * * * We read by the way the same account of Je Tsongkapa's partner as above in Pabongka Rinpoche Dechen Nyingpo's Sweet Essence of the Nectar of the Angels (ACIP digital text S00047, ff. 9a-9b), except that in this text the Lady's hat is described as golden rather than crimson; and She reveals herself in divine form after Je Rinpoche finishes composing His famed Illumination of Every Secret Point. * * * We do by the way see a much earlier occasion in Je Rinpoche's life when He enjoyed a close relationship with the Lady of Song, Sarasvati.  Jamyang Shepay Dorje, in His instructions for the paintings depicting the Master's life (ACIP digital text S00072, f. 4b), describes how in his early 20's Je Tsongkapa did retreats to try to reach this Angel, succeeded, and then composed poetry in praise of Her: the very first thing in fact that Je Tsongkapa ever wrote.  Here is a sample of His poetry to this Lady, a piece from A Ritual for Inviting, and then Making Praise and Supplication to, the Goddess of Melody (ACIP digital text S05275-51, f. 46b):

20554.acip: RTAGS BSGYUR TSUL 'DI KYE RDOR GYI RGYUD NAS GSUNGS PA'I MAN NGAG YIN, DE YANG BUD MED KYI GZUGS SPONG TSUL DMIGS PA BSGYUR NAS SPONG BA YIN GYI, RTEN BSGYUR BA MA YIN LA, DE YANG ZHAL GCIG PHYAG GNYIS PA DANG, SKU MDOG NAG PA DANG, GRI THOD 'DZIN PA SPONG BA MA YIN GYI, LHA MOR 'JOG PA'I RTAGS THUN MONG MA YIN PA NU MA RGYAS PA DANG, BHA GA'I RNAM PA BSGYUR BA'O, ,
20554.wylie: rtags bsgyur tshul 'di kye rdor gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i man ngag yin, de yang bud med kyi gzugs spong tshul dmigs pa bsgyur nas spong ba yin gyi, rten bsgyur ba ma yin la, de yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang, sku mdog nag pa dang, gri thod 'dzin pa spong ba ma yin gyi, lha mor 'jog pa'i rtags thun mong ma yin pa nu ma rgyas pa dang, bha ga'i rnam pa bsgyur ba'o,
20554.english: The process of changing sexes here is an instruction spoken in the secret teachings of Lo Diamond.  When you relinquish the form of a woman, by the way, you do so in your visualization; it's not that your body actually changes.  And it's not that you give up the various characteristics of having one head and two arms, of having a dark color and holding the chopknife and skull.  Rather, what transform are the unique features that identify you as a female Angel: your breasts with their erect nipples, and your bhaga.

20755.acip: DE LTA BU'I PHYAG RGYA DE NYID, THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I SNOD RUNG DU BYAS PA, LHA'I RNAL 'BYOR SHIN TU BRTAN CING BYANG SEMS 'PHO MED DU PHAt YIG GI STOBS KYIS 'DZIN NUS PA, CHOS RNAMS KYI DE KHO NA NYID DANG 'DOD PA'I SGYU RTZAL DRUG CU RTZA BZHI SHES PAS BDE STONG SBYOR BA LA MKHAS PA DGOS TE,
20755.wylie: de lta bu'i phyag rgya de nyid, thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i snod rung du byas pa, lha'i rnal 'byor shin tu brtan cing byang sems 'pho med du phaT yig gi stobs kyis 'dzin nus pa, chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid dang 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi shes pas bde stong sbyor ba la mkhas pa dgos te
20755.english: This very same spiritual partner should have already been made into a proper vessel for both the shared path and the unique path.  Their practice of the Angel should be very firm, and they must be capable of using the force of the phet syllable to prevent the element of enlightenment from passing out.  And they must be a master at combining bliss and emptiness: they should understand the suchness of all existing things, and also the 64 arts of pleasure.

20802.acip: RJE BLA MAS RJE BTZUN RAN MDA' BAR PHUL PA'I GDAMS PA LAS, MTSAN NYID KYI THEG PA'I GNAD GSUM GONG DU BSTAN PA RNAMS KYANG SHES, SNGAGS KYI THABS LAM GYI GDAMS NGAG KYANG YOD PA KLU SGRUB DANG ZLA GRAGS 'DRA BA DE MTSAN NYID THEG PA RKYANG PA'I GDUL BYA LAS MYUR PA DANG CHES KHYAD PAR DU 'PHAGS PA YIN GYI, MTSAN NYID KYI LAM GYI GNAD MED PA'I SNGAGS KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GDUL BYA DE MTSAN NYID KYI GDUL BYA LAS DMAN,
20802.wylie: rje bla mas rje btsun ran mda' bar phul pa'i gdams pa las, mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i gnad gsum gong du bstan pa rnams kyang shes, sngags kyi thabs lam gyi gdams ngag kyang yod pa klu sgrub dang zla grags 'dra ba de mtshan nyid theg pa rkyang pa'i gdul bya las myur pa dang ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin gyi, mtshan nyid kyi lam gyi gnad med pa'i sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya de mtshan nyid kyi gdul bya las dman
20802.english: We see the following words of advice that Je Rinpoche offered to the holy Lama Rendawa: Suppose then we come across a person who first of all understands the three crucial points of the open path of the rational, as we have described them above.  And on top of this they also possess the advices of the special methods of the path of the secret way.  Such a disciple is then similar to Arya Nagarjuna, and Master Chandrakirti, and is vastly superior to a student who knows only of the open path of the rational--they move along the path much more quickly. We should point out as well though that a disciple of this unique path of the secret word who lacks the crucial points of the teachings of this path of the rational is worse than a disciple who is limited to the rational.

20921.acip: THOGS MED PA ZHES PA NI, GANG GIS KYANG GZHOM DU MI NUS PA'I DON DU BSHAD PAS, SNGAGS KYI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GRUB MTHA' LAS GZHAN DU BKRI MI NUS PA DANG,
20921.wylie: thogs med pa zhes pa ni, gang gis kyang gzhom du mi nus pa'i don du bshad pas, sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' las gzhan du bkri mi nus pa dang
20921.english: The word "untouchable" is often explained as referring to someone who cannot be overcome by another.  The expression here means that one should reach the point where they could never be led off into any system of belief other than the unique way of the secret word.

21035.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BDEN PA GNYIS KYI DON MA LUS PA YONGS SU SPYOD CING, BDE BA CHEN PO'I 'BRAS BU MCHOG LA DGA' BA'I GDUL BYA RNAMS LA, NYAN THOS DANG LDAN PA DANG, PHAR PHYIN GYI MDO SDE'I TSUL DANG LDAN PA'I CHAGS BRAL GYI SPYOD PA MA GSUNGS TE,
21035.wylie: thun mong ma yin pa'i bden pa gnyis kyi don ma lus pa yongs su spyod cing, bde ba chen po'i 'bras bu mchog la dga' ba'i gdul bya rnams la, nyan thos dang ldan pa dang, phar phyin gyi mdo sde'i tshul dang ldan pa'i chags bral gyi spyod pa ma gsungs te
21035.english: Now there are certain disciples who delight in the full performance of activities related to the every point of the unique form of the two truths--disciples who delight in ultimate goal of great bliss.  The paths of the listener, and the open ways of the perfection, which did not involve the use of desire were not taught to such as these.

21065.acip: 'DIR RGYUD SDE NAS LAN CIG MA YIN PAR GSUNGS PA'I PHYAG RGYA SROG RTZOL GYI GNAD MTHAR THUG RJE BLA MA'I LEGS BSHAD THUN MONG MA YIN PA, GSANG BA LAS KYANG CHES GSANG BA'I GNAD RNAMS BRJED BYANG DU BRI BAR 'TSAL NA,
21065.wylie: 'dir rgyud sde nas lan cig ma yin par gsungs pa'i phyag rgya srog rtsol gyi gnad mthar thug rje bla ma'i legs bshad thun mong ma yin pa, gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i gnad rnams brjed byang du bri bar 'tshal na
21065.english: Here I shall seek to set down the excellent words of our Lord Lama, the ultimate keys for the practice of training the winds with a spiritual partner--an instruction which has been spoken in the body of the secret teachings no few times.  These are unique and crucial points, secret beyond all secrets, and I record them here to keep me from forgetting any of them.

21073.acip: JO BO NA RO TA PAS GZHAN LA MA GNANG BA'I, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GDAMS NGAG, RJE BTZUN PHAM THING BA SKU MCHED LA GDAMS NGAG GNANG BA NI,
21073.wylie: jo bo na ro ta pas gzhan la ma gnang ba'i, thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag, rje btsun pham thing ba sku mched la gdams ngag gnang ba ni
21073.english: There are certain unique advices which the Lord, Naropa, granted to no one else but the Venerable Ones, the Pamtingpa brothers.   These advices covered the following topics:

21414.acip: DPE DE LTA BU'I RGYA MTSO'I NGOGS SU 'KHRUNGS PA'I SDONG PO ME TOG DRI LDAN RNAMS KYI RTZER, TSUL KHRIMS TING 'DZIN SHES RAB KYI (BSLAB) PA (GSUM) DANG, THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAM GYI RIM PA GNYIS SAM, BSKYED RDZOGS KYI LAM (RIM) PA (GNYIS) DANG, TSOGS LAM, SBYOR LAM, MTHONG LAM, SGOM LAM, MI SLOB LAM STE (LAM LNGA'I 'BRAS) BU DANG LDAN PA NI, RTOGS PA'I YON TAN DANG,
21414.wylie: dpe de lta bu'i rgya mtsho'i ngogs su 'khrungs pa'i sdong po me tog dri ldan rnams kyi rtser, tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab kyi (bslab) pa (gsum) dang, thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rim pa gnyis sam, bskyed rdzogs kyi lam (rim) pa (gnyis) dang, tshogs lam, sbyor lam, mthong lam, sgom lam, mi slob lam ste (lam lnga'i 'bras) bu dang ldan pa ni, rtogs pa'i yon tan dang
21414.english: And so we are picturing here the metaphor of sprouts or stems of flowers which have risen forth at the edge of an ocean: the stems then sprout the fragrant blooms, and the tips of these blooms in turn give forth fruits--which in this case are qualities of the mind, of realizations.  Examples of these fruits would be the three extraordinary trainings of morality, meditation, and wisdom; as well as the two stages.  This can refer either to the steps of the path which are shared and those which are unique; or else to the paths of the stage of creation and the stage of completion.  Included in the fruits as well are those of the five paths, meaning the path of accumulation; the path of preparation; the path of seeing; the path of habituation; and the path of no more learning.

21544.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA LTAR NA SGO GSUM SO SO DANG THUN MONG THA MAL DU 'DZIN PA'I SNANG ZHEN GYI DRI MA RNAMS SBYANGS TE, BUM DBANG, GSANG DBANG, SHES RAB YE SHES KYI DBANG, DBANG BZHI PA STE (RNAM) PAR (DAG) PA'I (DBANG BZHI) RIM PA BZHIN DU (THOB) PA'I NUS PAS, 'BRAS BU SPRUL SKU, LONGS SKU, CHOS SKU, ZUNG 'JUG GI SKU STE (SKU BZHI THOB) PAR BSAM PA'AM 'THOB PAR 'GYUR BA'I NUS PA KHYAD PAR CAN BZHAG BYUNG SNYAM DU BSAM PA YIN (CING,)
21544.wylie: thun mong ma yin pa ltar na sgo gsum so so dang thun mong tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen gyi dri ma rnams sbyangs te, bum dbang, gsang dbang, shes rab ye shes kyi dbang, dbang bzhi pa ste (rnam) par (dag) pa'i (dbang bzhi) rim pa bzhin du (thob) pa'i nus pas, 'bras bu sprul sku, longs sku, chos sku, zung 'jug gi sku ste (sku bzhi thob) par bsam pa'am 'thob par 'gyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag byung snyam du bsam pa yin (cing,)
21544.english: Relative to the teachings which are unique, we are being cleaned of impurities which relate to the three doors of expression individually--and to all of them together--where we grasp to things as being everyday.  We are receiving, one after the other, four pure empowerments: the empowerment of the vase, the secret empowerment, the empowerment of a Woman of Wisdom, and the "fourth empowerment."  And we have to think to ourselves that, due to the power of these empowerments, there is as well planted within us an exceptional capacity to attain the result of the four holy bodies: the body of emanation, the paradise body, the Dharma body, and the body of the Union of the Two.

21550.acip: 'DI LA LNGA, THEG CHEN THUN MONG BA'I LAM, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAM, 'PHO BA 'DEBS TSUL, BLA MA DANG MI 'BRAL BAR SMON TSUL, ,MTHAR BLA MA RANG LA BSDUS NAS SPYOD LAM JI LTAR BYED TSUL LO,,
21550.wylie: 'di la lnga, theg chen thun mong ba'i lam, thun mong ma yin pa'i lam, 'pho ba 'debs tshul, bla ma dang mi 'bral bar smon tshul, ,mthar bla ma rang la bsdus nas spyod lam ji ltar byed tshul lo
21550.english: Here there are five parts: an explanation of how we make a prayer concerning the shared path of the greater way; a prayer concerning the unique path of the greater way; concerning how we perform the practice of sending our consciousness on; on how we pray never to be parted from our Lama; and lastly the way in which, at the end of the practice, we gather our Lama into us and then go about our daily life.

22471.acip: DPER NA RTA LTA BU GCIG LA YANG RGYA GAR RGYA NAG BOD SOG PO SOGS KYIS RANG RANG GI YUL SKAD SNA TSOGS KYI MING GIS BRJOD PA BZHIN DANG, SHER PHYIN BYAMS PAS ZHUS PA LAS GZUGS SOGS KYI CHOS THAMS CAD LA YANG MING GLO BUR DU BTAGS PAR GSUNGS PAS MING 'JUG PA NI BRDA'I DBANG YIN GYI, DNGOS PO'I DBANG GIS MIN NO,,
22471.wylie: dper na rta lta bu gcig la yang rgya gar rgya nag bod sog po sogs kyis rang rang gi yul skad sna tshogs kyi ming gis brjod pa bzhin dang, sher phyin byams pas zhus pa las gzugs sogs kyi chos thams cad la yang ming glo bur du btags par gsungs pas ming 'jug pa ni brda'i dbang yin gyi, dngos po'i dbang gis min no
22471.english: We see for example the single object of a horse referred to in a variety of words from different languages—languages like Sanskrit or Chinese, or Tibetan or Mongolian. And the text on the perfection of wisdom requested by Maitreya states as well that the words which apply to every single object there is, from physical form on up, are applied artificially.[152] As such, the way that names apply to their objects is something that occurs only in words, and not through some natural connection.

22485.acip: SPRIN NI KLU SOGS KYI BSAM PA'I DBANG GIS MKHA' LA SKYE ZHING 'JIG PA LTAR 'DUS BYAS RNAMS NI, THUN MONG DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAS DBANG GIS SKYE 'JIG BYED BAR 'GYUR ZHES PA'I DPE RNAMS KYIS KYANG 'DUS BYAS
22485.wylie: sprin ni klu sogs kyi bsam pa'i dbang gis mkha' la skye zhing 'jig pa ltar 'dus byas rnams ni, thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i las dbang gis skye 'jig byed bar 'gyur zhes pa'i dpe rnams kyis kyang 'dus byas
22485.english: THAMS CAD BDEN MED DU BSHAD DO,, Clouds are something that gather and fade in the sky, depending on the wishes of the dragons and such. Things brought about by causes are the same; depending on the influence of karma which is either communal or not, they rise or die out. Each of the metaphors above is also meant to represent how no object brought about by causes has any true existence.

26983.acip: DMIGS PA GZUGS SGRA DRI RO REG BYA STE, DON LNGA DANG RANG GI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I BDAG 'BRAS SU GYUR PA'I SEMS CAN GYI DBANG PO GZUGS CAN PA LNGA DANG, GANG ZAG DANG CHOS KYI BDAG 'DZIN GYI BAG CHAGS GSUM LA DMIGS NAS,
26983.wylie: dmigs pa gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste, don lnga dang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag 'bras su gyur pa'i sems can gyi dbang po gzugs can pa lnga dang, gang zag dang chos kyi bdag 'dzin gyi bag chags gsum la dmigs nas
26983.english: This part is focused upon three different things.  First there are the five objects: visible forms, sounds, smells, tastes, and tangibles.  Secondly there are the five results, subsumed within a person, which are triggered by these five and correspond to each of them individually: the five physical sense powers.  And then finally there are the karmic propensities for the tendency to hold that individuals and things have some nature of their own.

27011.acip: DE'I PHYIR MNGON PA BA KHA CIG GIS KUN GZHI GCIG LA 'DOD GZUGS GNYIS KA SNANG BAR 'DOD PA DANG, LA LAS BSAM GTAN BZHI PA NI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I LAS KYIS BSKYED PAS MI SNANG LA, GZHAN THAMS CAD SNANG BAR 'DOD PA DANG,
27011.wylie: de'i phyir mngon pa ba kha cig gis kun gzhi gcig la 'dod gzugs gnyis ka snang bar 'dod pa dang, la las bsam gtan bzhi pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i las kyis bskyed pas mi snang la, gzhan thams cad snang bar 'dod pa dang
27011.english: This is why some followers of the teachings of higher knowledge believe that both the desire and form realms make their appearance to a single foundation consciousness.  There are others of this school who say that the fourth concentration level—as it is created by a unique type of karma—will not appear to this consciousness; but all the other levels do.

27065.acip: ,THUN MONG THUN MONG MA YIN DANG, ,TSOR DANG BCAS DANG TSOR MED PA'I, ,SA BON RNAM BZHI
27065.wylie: thun mong thun mong ma yin dang, ,tshor dang bcas dang tshor med pa'i, ,sa bon rnam bzhi
27065.english: Mental seeds are also Of four different types: Those for the communal; Those for the unique; Or that involve feeling, Or have no involvement with it.

27066.acip: ,SNOD KYI 'JIG RTEN 'GRUB PA'I THUN MONG GI SA BON DANG, BCUD KYI 'JIG RTEN 'GRUB PA'I THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I SA BON DANG, ,YANG BDE SDUG GI RTEN DU GYUR CING SEMS KYIS ZIN PAS NA BCUD KYI 'JIG RTEN 'GRUB PA'I TSOR BA DANG BCAS PA DANG DES MA ZIN PAS NA SNOD KYI 'JIG RTEN 'GRUB PA'I TSOR BA MED PA'I, ,SA BON TE DBYE TSUL RNAM PA BZHI DANG,
27066.wylie: snod kyi 'jig rten 'grub pa'i thun mong gi sa bon dang, bcud kyi 'jig rten 'grub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sa bon dang, ,yang bde sdug gi rten du gyur cing sems kyis zin pas na bcud kyi 'jig rten 'grub pa'i tshor ba dang bcas pa dang des ma zin pas na snod kyi 'jig rten 'grub pa'i tshor ba med pa'i, ,sa bon te dbye tshul rnam pa bzhi dang
27066.english: The types of mental seeds can also be presented as four different types: [1] Mental seeds “for the communal,” which bring about the great vessel of the world. [2] Mental seeds “for the unique,” which bring about the individual beings who inhabit this vessel. [3] Or else we can list the mental seeds that bring about the beings who inhabit the vessel in the sense of being the basis for pleasure and pain; as well as for what is “held” by consciousness—that is, seeds that involve the capacity of feeling; and [4] Mental seeds which bring about the outer vessel of the world in the sense of what is not held by consciousness—which is to say, seeds that have no involvement with the capacity of feeling. Another set of four mental seeds

27329.acip: ,KLU SGRUB 'PHAGS PA LHA YI GRUB PA'I MTHA', ,SHING RTA CHEN PO GSUM GYIS BKRAL BA NYID, ,THUN MONG MA YIN GNAD DON KUN RDZOGS PAR, ,DRI MED BLO GROS MIG GIS LEGS MTHONG ZHING,
27329.wylie: klu sgrub 'phags pa lha yi grub pa'i mtha', ,shing rta chen po gsum gyis bkral ba nyid, ,thun mong ma yin gnad don kun rdzogs par, ,dri med blo gros mig gis legs mthong zhing
27329.english: I have seen, perfectly, With the eyes of Immaculate wisdom, Each & every one Of the unique And crucial points In the philosophical system Of Nagarjuna and Aryadeva, Just as this was commented upon By every one of the three Magnificent innovators.

27338.acip: RANG GI LUGS NI RTZA BA SHES RAB LA 'JUG PA'I TSUL GNYIS YOD DE, ZAB PA DANG RGYA CHE BA'I SGO NAS SO, ,DE'I DANG PO NI RANG 'GREL LAS, ,LUGS 'DI NI THUN MONG MA YIN PA'O, ,ZHES MKHAS PA RNAMS KYIS NGES PAR BYA'O, ,ZHES PA DANG,
27338.wylie: rang gi lugs ni rtsa ba shes rab la 'jug pa'i tshul gnyis yod de, zab pa dang rgya che ba'i sgo nas so, ,de'i dang po ni rang 'grel las, ,lugs 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'o, ,zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis nges par bya'o, ,zhes pa dang
27338.english: Our own position is that there are two ways in which Master Chandrakirti's text enters into the Foundational Verses called “Wisdom.” One is through the profound side of the teachings, and the other is through the widespread side of the teachings. As for the first, the Autocommentary says that “Sages should understand one thing: that this is a truly unique system.”

27340.acip: ZHES RANG GIS DBU MA'I DON GTAN LA PHAB PA DE, DBU MA PA GZHAN DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PAR BSTAN PA DANG, BSTAN BCOS KYI DON RNAM PAR RIG PA TZAM DANG MTHUN PAR BSHAD DU MI RUNG BA LA NGES PA BSTAN PAR BYA BA'I PHYIR DU DBU MA LA 'JUG PA BRTZAMS PAR GSUNGS TE,
27340.wylie: zhes rang gis dbu ma'i don gtan la phab pa de, dbu ma pa gzhan dang thun mong ma yin par bstan pa dang, bstan bcos kyi don rnam par rig pa tsam dang mthun par bshad du mi rung ba la nges pa bstan par bya ba'i phyir du dbu ma la 'jug pa brtsams par gsungs te
27340.english: What Master Chandrakirti is saying here then is that “I have composed Entering the Middle Way to demonstrate, first of all, why the way that I set forth the meaning of emptiness is truly unique in comparison to the way it is set forth by other proponents of the Middle Way school. Secondly, I wish to demonstrate how one should come to an understanding that it is mistaken to explain emptiness in the same way as those who belong to the Mentalist School do.”

27485.acip: DE LTAR SEMS CAN YID LA SHIN TU GCES PA DANG, 'KHOR BA NA MNAR BA'I TSUL GNYIS KYI SGO NAS, SNYING RJE CHEN PO SBYONG BA LA 'BAD PA DE DAG GIS NI, ZLA BAS MCHOD BRJOD THUN MONG MA YIN PA MDZAD PA DON YOD PAR BYAS LA,
27485.wylie: de ltar sems can yid la shin tu gces pa dang, 'khor ba na mnar ba'i tshul gnyis kyi sgo nas, snying rje chen po sbyong ba la 'bad pa de dag gis ni, zla bas mchod brjod thun mong ma yin pa mdzad pa don yod par byas la
27485.english: Those who make a true effort at this point to develop the attitude of great compassion—through this dual methodology of learning to cherish living beings deeply, and contemplating how the cycle of life torments them—are giving meaning to the unique offering of praise which Master Chandrakirti has composed here.

27533.acip: GZHAN 'JUG PA'I YAN LAG DGOS 'BREL LA BRJOD BYA NI, ZAB PA DANG RGYA CHE BA GNYIS YIN LA, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I DGOS PA NI BSHAD ZIN TO,,
27533.wylie: gzhan 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'brel la brjod bya ni, zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis yin la, thun mong ma yin pa'i dgos pa ni bshad zin to
27533.english: This brings us to the preliminaries of the composition which are meant to inspire others to engage in the work: what we sometimes call “the purpose & the connection.” The first traditional part is called “a statement of the subject matter”—which in this case includes both the profound teachings and the widespread teachings. The second part, what we call the “unique purpose,” has already been covered.

27576.acip: ZAG PA MED PA'I YE SHES ZHES PA'I NGO BO NI, KHA CIG MDZOD NAS BSHAD PA LTAR GYI ZAG PA RGYAS SU MI RUNG BA LA ZAG MED DU 'CHAD PA NI, LUGS 'DI'I ZAG MED DU 'JOG PA'I DON THUN MONG MA YIN PA MA RTOGS PAR SNANG BAS,
27576.wylie: zag pa med pa'i ye shes zhes pa'i ngo bo ni, kha cig mdzod nas bshad pa ltar gyi zag pa rgyas su mi rung ba la zag med du 'chad pa ni, lugs 'di'i zag med du 'jog pa'i don thun mong ma yin pa ma rtogs par snang bas
27576.english: What then is the essence of immaculate wisdom? Some have glossed “immaculate” here as it is explained in The Treasure House—as referring to an instance where stains can no longer spread. It would appear that these people have failed to grasp the unique way in which something is described as “immaculate” in this particular system.

27638.acip: THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I DGA' BA SKYES PAS, RAB TU DGA' BA MANG BA'I PHYIR, RGYAL SRAS DE DGA' BA MCHOG TU GYUR PA 'CHANG BA YANG YIN NO, ,RAB DGA' KHYAD PAR DU 'PHAGS PA YOD PA'I PHYIR SA 'DI LA RAB TU DGA' BA ZHES KYANG BYA'O,,
27638.wylie: thun mong ma yin pa'i dga' ba skyes pas, rab tu dga' ba mang ba'i phyir, rgyal sras de dga' ba mchog tu gyur pa 'chang ba yang yin no, ,rab dga' khyad par du 'phags pa yod pa'i phyir sa 'di la rab tu dga' ba zhes kyang bya'o
27638.english: As such, they come to feel a truly unique form of happiness; and are thus filled with many different kinds of perfect happiness. Because of this we can also say, “This level is named Perfect Happiness, since the son or daughter of the Victors holds in their hands a supreme form of happiness, and their perfect happiness itself is one which is truly superior.”

27798.acip: DE LTAR THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GANG ZAG GI BDAG MED KYI 'JOG TSUL MDZAD PHYIN CHAD, GANG ZAG GI BDAG MED THUN MONG BA TZAM GYI DBANG DU MDZAD NAS, 'JIG LTA LA SOGS PA'I NGOS 'DZIN MDZAD PA'I NYON MONGS KYI RNAM GZHAG RNAMS SOR BZHAG TU MDZAD NA, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I GRUB MTHA', MTHA' MA CHOD PA'I NOR PA CHEN POR 'GYUR BAS, DE LA MKHAS PA'I DBANG PO 'DI 'KHRUL BA GA LA SRID,
27798.wylie: de ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i gang zag gi bdag med kyi 'jog tshul mdzad phyin chad, gang zag gi bdag med thun mong ba tsam gyi dbang du mdzad nas, 'jig lta la sogs pa'i ngos 'dzin mdzad pa'i nyon mongs kyi rnam gzhag rnams sor bzhag tu mdzad na, thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha', mtha' ma chod pa'i nor pa chen por 'gyur bas, de la mkhas pa'i dbang po 'di 'khrul ba ga la srid
27798.english: And so suppose we start with a thinker who was actually the one who set forth the way of defining the lack of a self-nature to the person in a way which was not shared by the different systems; and who supposedly then limited themselves to the shared concept of this particular lack of a self-nature; and who then set aside the presentation of the negative emotions which correctly identifies the view of destruction and so on; and thus made the stupendous error of failing to thresh out the views of this very unique school of thought…how could this Lord of All Sages ever possibly make such a mistake?

27799.acip: DES NA NYAN RANG LA CHOS KYI BDAG MED RTOGS PA YOD PAR BSHAD PA'I GZHUNG 'DZUGS PAR SGOM ZHING, NYON MONGS KYI RNAM GZHAG LA THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I 'JOG TSUL YOD DAM MED SNYAM PA TZAM YANG MI SKYE BA'I 'DI'I RJES 'BRANG RNAMS NI, LUGS 'DI LA DAD PA TZAM DU ZAD DO, ,'DIS MTSON NAS GZHAN YANG MANG DU SNANG BA RNAMS LEGS PAR RTZAD GCAD PAR BYA'O,,
27799.wylie: des na nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par bshad pa'i gzhung 'dzugs par sgom zhing, nyon mongs kyi rnam gzhag la thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jog tshul yod dam med snyam pa tsam yang mi skye ba'i 'di'i rjes 'brang rnams ni, lugs 'di la dad pa tsam du zad do, ,'dis mtshon nas gzhan yang mang du snang ba rnams legs par rtsad gcad par bya'o
27799.english: So what we have here is a person who has failed to sit down and put in front of their mind the great classics which explain how listeners & self-made buddhas do possess the perception that there is no self-nature to things; and to whom it has never even occurred to examine whether or not there is a unique way of setting forth how the negative emotions work. And then we have all of those who have followed this person, and who possess no more than a blind faith in our school. And all these people are only one example that we have dealt with here; there appear to be many others like them, and you should learn to scrutinize their views carefully.

27907.acip: GSUM PA LA BZHI, BYANG SEMS KYI SBYIN PA'I PHAN YON THUN MONG MA YIN PA BSTAN PA, RTEN GNYIS KA LA SBYIN PA'I GTAM GTZO BOR BSTAN PA, BYANG SEMS KYIS SBYIN PA'I TSE DGA' BA JI 'DRA BA 'THOB PA BSTAN PA, BYANG SEMS KYIS LUS SBYIN PA LA SDUG BSNGAL YOD MED BSTAN PA'O,,
27907.wylie: gsum pa la bzhi, byang sems kyi sbyin pa'i phan yon thun mong ma yin pa bstan pa, rten gnyis ka la sbyin pa'i gtam gtso bor bstan pa, byang sems kyis sbyin pa'i tshe dga' ba ji 'dra ba 'thob pa bstan pa, byang sems kyis lus sbyin pa la sdug bsngal yod med bstan pa'o
27907.english: This brings us to the third of our four steps from before—an explanation of the giving practiced by bodhisattvas. We proceed in four sections: a description of the unique type of giving practiced by a bodhisattva; a description of how the discussion of giving is primary for both types of people; a description of the kind of happiness that a bodhisattva feels when they are giving; and a description of whether or not a bodhisattva feels pain when they give away their own body. Happiness comes from giving

28238.acip: DE'I PHYIR 'GOG PA LA SNYOMS PAR 'JUG PA THUN MONG MA YIN PA 'DI NAS 'THOB PA YIN NO,,
28238.wylie: de'i phyir 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug pa thun mong ma yin pa 'di nas 'thob pa yin no
28238.english: And thus it is from this level that we attain a unique form of deep meditation upon the ending of certain undesirable qualities.

28407.acip: 'OG NAS RANG RGYUD PAS RIGS PAS 'GOG TSUL THUN MONG MA YIN PA RNAMS MI STON PAS, 'DIR DE'I LUGS KYIS CHOS THAMS CAD SGYU MA BZHIN DU 'CHAR TSUL MDOR BSDUS GO SLA BAR BRJOD NA,
28407.wylie: 'og nas rang rgyud pas rigs pas 'gog tshul thun mong ma yin pa rnams mi ston pas, 'dir de'i lugs kyis chos thams cad sgyu ma bzhin du 'char tshul mdor bsdus go sla bar brjod na
28407.english: We don't cover, later on in this text, the unique manner in which the Independent group does their denial of real existence through the use of reasoning. As such, let us here relate, in brief, the way in which their system describes how all existing things make their appearance, in the manner of an illusion.

28444.acip: RTOG PAS BZHAG PA DE LA RANG RANG GI BYA BYED 'THAD PA NI, TSIG DANG DON GYI 'GREL MDZAD RNAMS KYI NANG NAS, SANGS RGYAS BSKYANGS DANG ZHI BA LHA DANG SLOB DPON 'DI GSUM GYIS 'PHAGS PA YAB SRAS GNYIS KYI 'GREL LUGS THUN MONG MA YIN PA'O, ,DBU MA'I LTA BA MTHAR THUG PA'I DKA' SA YANG 'DI NYID DO,,
28444.wylie: rtog pas bzhag pa de la rang rang gi bya byed 'thad pa ni, tshig dang don gyi 'grel mdzad rnams kyi nang nas, sangs rgyas bskyangs dang zhi ba lha dang slob dpon 'di gsum gyis 'phags pa yab sras gnyis kyi 'grel lugs thun mong ma yin pa'o, ,dbu ma'i lta ba mthar thug pa'i dka' sa yang 'di nyid do
28444.english: Let's talk about the concept that things which are creations of ideas can nonetheless quite properly perform their individual functions. Of all those who have written commentaries upon both the wording & meaning of these scriptures, three have captured the unique thinking of the Realized One and his spiritual son on this question; these are Buddha Palita, Shantideva, and our master here. This is in fact the ultimate point of difficulty in understanding the view of the middle way.

28534.acip: 'DI LA GRANGS CAN PA RNAMS RGYU RKYEN PHAN TSUN SO SO THA DAD PA RNAMS LA 'BRAS BU THUN MONG BA GCIG NI YOD LA, DE YANG RGYU RKYEN RNAMS LA RANG BZHIN GCIG PA'I GTZO BO GCIG RJES SU 'GRO BA MED NA MI RUNG BAS, RGYU NAS KYI RANG BZHIN GANG YIN PA YANG, RKYEN CHU LUD SOGS KYI RANG BZHIN YIN LA,
28534.wylie: 'di la grangs can pa rnams rgyu rkyen phan tshun so so tha dad pa rnams la 'bras bu thun mong ba gcig ni yod la, de yang rgyu rkyen rnams la rang bzhin gcig pa'i gtso bo gcig rjes su 'gro ba med na mi rung bas, rgyu nas kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa yang, rkyen chu lud sogs kyi rang bzhin yin la
28534.english: Now the followers of the Numerist School say that a single, shared result comes from causes & conditions which are distinct from one another. They assert that it would be wrong to say that these causes & conditions did not follow upon a single primal cause; thus the nature of the cause—say, a grain of barley—must be the nature of the conditions, things like the water and the fertilizer.

28835.acip: TSUL DE DAG NI MIG LA RTA GLANG DU SNANG BA'I SGYU MA DANG BRAG CHA SOGS LA YANG SHES PAR BYA STE, LUGS DAM PA 'DI YI RNAM GZHAG THUN MONG MA YIN PA'O,,
28835.wylie: tshul de dag ni mig la rta glang du snang ba'i sgyu ma dang brag cha sogs la yang shes par bya ste, lugs dam pa 'di yi rnam gzhag thun mong ma yin pa'o
28835.english: You should understand that these descriptions apply as well to cases such as where an illusion appears to the eye as though it were a horse or elephant; or where there is an echo. This is a unique presentation of this highest of all systems of thought. The blind do not disprove the seeing

28845.acip: DANG PO LA GNYIS, DNGOS KYI DON DANG, NYON MONGS KYI RNAM GZHAG THUN MONG MA YIN PA BSHAD PA'O, ,DANG PO NI,
28845.wylie: dang po la gnyis, dngos kyi don dang, nyon mongs kyi rnam gzhag thun mong ma yin pa bshad pa'o, ,dang po ni
28845.english: The first of these will have two parts of its own: a description of the actual point, followed by an explanation of this unique presentation on the negative emotions.

28884.acip: LUGS 'DI LA NYON MONGS KYI NGOS 'DZIN MNGON PA GONG 'OG NAS BSHAD PA DANG MI MTHUN PA THUN MONG MA YIN PA CIG YOD PA DE SHES PA GAL CHE BAR SNANG BAS DE BSHAD NA,
28884.wylie: lugs 'di la nyon mongs kyi ngos 'dzin mngon pa gong 'og nas bshad pa dang mi mthun pa thun mong ma yin pa cig yod pa de shes pa gal che bar snang bas de bshad na
28884.english: The present system has a way of identifying the negative emotions which is unique—that is to say, it is not shared with the explanation of these emotions found in the higher & lower divisions of the system called Higher Knowledge. It seems to me that a knowledge of this presentation is quite important, and so I will cover it here.

28894.acip: DE RNAMS GRUB NA BDEN 'DZIN DE DE KHO NA NYID KYI DON RIG PA'I 'GAL BA MI MTHUN PHYOGS SU 'GRUB PAS, MA RIG PAR 'GRUB CING, DE MA ZAD PAR {%BAR} DU 'JIG LTA YANG MI 'DZAD PAR SGRUB NUS PAS, NYON MONGS CAN GYI MA RIG PAR 'GRUB PAS NYON MONGS KYI RNAM GZHAG THUN MONG MA YIN PA 'JOG SHES PA SHIN TU GAL CHE'O,,
28894.wylie: de rnams grub na bden 'dzin de de kho na nyid kyi don rig pa'i 'gal ba mi mthun phyogs su 'grub pas, ma rig par 'grub cing, de ma zad par {%bar} du 'jig lta yang mi 'dzad par sgrub nus pas, nyon mongs can gyi ma rig par 'grub pas nyon mongs kyi rnam gzhag thun mong ma yin pa 'jog shes pa shin tu gal che'o
28894.english: Once these things are established, they can establish that the tendency to see things as real constitutes the direct, contradictory opposite of understanding suchness. With this, they have established what constitutes misunderstanding. Since we can prove that—until we finish this off—we could never finish off the view of destruction either, then once we have established what misunderstanding involved with negative emotions is, we can posit a unique presentation on the negative emotions. Understanding all this is extremely important.

28920.acip: DE DAG LA BRTEN NAS NGA RGYAL SOGS KYANG SHES PAR NUS LA, THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I MA RIG PA DANG 'JIG LTA DANG MTHAR LTA LA YANG KUN BRTAGS DANG LHAN SKYES GNYIS KA SHES PAR BYA STE TSIG MANGS SU DOGS NAS MA BRIS SO,,
28920.wylie: de dag la brten nas nga rgyal sogs kyang shes par nus la, thun mong ma yin pa'i ma rig pa dang 'jig lta dang mthar lta la yang kun brtags dang lhan skyes gnyis ka shes par bya ste tshig mangs su dogs nas ma bris so
28920.english: Based on our presentation so far, you can understand the situation with other negative emotions, such as pride. You can also understand that there are learned & innate forms of this unique form of misunderstanding; and to the view of destruction; and to extreme views. It is only out of fear for going on too long that I will avoid describing these details here in the present work.

29181.acip: 'PHAGS PA'I GZHUNG 'GREL TSUL LA RANG GI MTSAN NYID KYIS GRUB PA RDUL TZAM MED KYANG, BYA BYED THAMS CAD BZHAG PAS CHOG PA'I 'GREL TSUL GYI LUGS THUN MONG MA YIN PA 'DI LA BRTEN NAS, RNAM PAR DAG PA'I GRUB MTHA' 'GREL BYED GZHAN DANG THUN MONG MA YIN PA MANG DU YOD DE,
29181.wylie: 'phags pa'i gzhung 'grel tshul la rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa rdul tsam med kyang, bya byed thams cad bzhag pas chog pa'i 'grel tshul gyi lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'di la brten nas, rnam par dag pa'i grub mtha' 'grel byed gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa mang du yod de
29181.english: As far as commenting upon the classic of the Realized One, this is a truly unique way of doing it; where we say that—even though there does not exist even the tiniest bit of anything which could ever exist by definition—still we can go ahead and posit the entire system in which things do what they do. And based upon this kind of presentation, there are many other points here that are not held in common even with other commentators who belong to quite accurate schools of thought.

29182.acip: DE GANG ZHE NA RE ZHIG GTZO BO RNAMS BRJOD NA, TSOGS DRUG LAS NGO BO THA DAD PA'I KUN GZHI RNAM SHES DANG, RANG RIG 'GOG LUGS THUN MONG MA YIN PA DANG, RANG RGYUD KYI SBYOR BAS PHYIR RGOL GYI RGYUD LA DE KHO NA NYID KYI LTA BA SKYED PA KHAS MI LEN PA GSUM DANG,
29182.wylie: de gang zhe na re zhig gtso bo rnams brjod na, tshogs drug las ngo bo tha dad pa'i kun gzhi rnam shes dang, rang rig 'gog lugs thun mong ma yin pa dang, rang rgyud kyi sbyor bas phyir rgol gyi rgyud la de kho na nyid kyi lta ba skyed pa khas mi len pa gsum dang
29182.english: And what are those points?
